items.name: Boulder Holiday Bash 2025
items.information: We're excited to welcome competitors back to Boulder for another fun day of speedcubing! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important! This competition has a 100 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition! Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:20 AM. If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (12:00 AM UTC 12-31-2024) This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzg0NzEsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--e7429bea0d8a072b28438bc1328d960e54d128b9/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png) You are welcome to join the Facebook Group [Rubik's Cube Solvers Vancouver](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494) Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. Competitors are only allowed to register for a maximum of four events. Please see the "Favorites Format" tab for more info. The events will happen in the order listed on the "Schedule" tab, but event durations are tentative! Check back the day before the competition, as event durations may change depending on the number of competitors in events. You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case Spectators can attend for free. Due to venue capacity, we ask that competitors bring a maximum of 1 guest each. To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time. **Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. **Health and Safety** Masks will be optional at this event. Please stay home if you are sick or feeling unwell.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzYzOTcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--40d6a92906ae7958b380fe38d926638d59b4dabd/MIRA%20LABS%20LOGO%20COLORED.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc4ODcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b16871971da44f65ec3100f26afb9b425073d72e/CITYMALL%20MINI%20BANNER.png) Mira Labs is excited to announce our inaugural WCA competition, **Mira Labs Cubing Scientists in Bacolod 2025**! This event welcomes participants of all ages and skill levels, with generous cut-off times to encourage broader participation. The 3x3x3 cube, our main event, will feature three thrilling rounds, while the 2x2x2 cube will have two rounds. To revive the community’s interest in specialized categories, we’re also offering two rounds for Clock and Square-1, while the remaining events will each feature a single, intense round. By registering, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge that the organizing bodies, their staff, and affiliated individuals will not be liable for any injuries, loss of personal belongings, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this event. Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating in this event.

items.name: Ottawa Mini Winter A 2025
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) [EN] ### OCDSB Students! OCDSB students (Elementary and Secondary students) compete for free! Please add the following note in the comments of your registration: "OCDSB Student, my student email is {student email here}" Please do not pay the registration fee. ### Ottawa Mini Winter Series This competition is in a series with Ottawa Mini Winter B 2025 (Saturday Morning) and Ottawa Mini Winter C 2025 (Saturday Afternoon). You will only be able to compete in one of these three competitions. Attempting to register for multiple of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ### Registration Reminders If you are not a OCDSB student, you must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. --- [FR] ### Les élèves de l'OCDSB! Les élèves de l'OCDSB (élèves du primaire et du secondaire) participent gratuitement aux compétitions! Veuillez ajouter la note suivante dans les commentaires de votre inscription: "Étudiant de l'OCDSB, mon email d'étudiant est {email d'étudiant ici}". Ne payez pas les frais d'inscription. ### Série d'hiver d'Ottawa Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec Ottawa Mini Winter B 2025 (samedi matin) et Ottawa Mini Winter C 2025 (samedi après-midi). Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à une seule de ces trois compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plusieurs de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Si vous n'êtes pas un étudiant de l'OCDSB, vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.name: Chill Out Trondheim 2025
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Chill Out Trondheim 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 50kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025#51927-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Chill Out Trondheim 2025! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 50 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025#51927-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) [EN] ### OCDSB Students! OCDSB students (Elementary and Secondary students) compete for free! Please add the following note in the comments of your registration: "OCDSB Student, my student email is {student email here}" Please do not pay the registration fee. ### Ottawa Mini Winter Series This competition is in a series with [Ottawa Mini Winter A 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OttawaMiniWinterA2025) (Friday Evening) and [Ottawa Mini Winter C 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OttawaMiniWinterC2025) (Saturday Afternoon). You will only be able to compete in one of these three competitions. Attempting to register for multiple of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ### Registration Reminders If you are not a OCDSB student, you must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. --- [FR] ### Les élèves de l'OCDSB! Les élèves de l'OCDSB (élèves du primaire et du secondaire) participent gratuitement aux compétitions! Veuillez ajouter la note suivante dans les commentaires de votre inscription: "Étudiant de l'OCDSB, mon email d'étudiant est {email d'étudiant ici}". Ne payez pas les frais d'inscription. ### Série d'hiver d'Ottawa Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec Ottawa Mini Winter A 2025 (vendredi soir) et Ottawa Mini Winter C 2025 (samedi après-midi). Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à une seule de ces trois compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plusieurs de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Si vous n'êtes pas un étudiant de l'OCDSB, vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: ##Português: **Competidores, atenção aos seguintes avisos:** - Esta competição *não terá a modalidade* ***3x3x3*** ; - Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar**. Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com a organização**; - O competidor poderá se inscrever antecipadamente pelo site e sua inscrição será confirmada apenas com o pagamento da taxa via PIX: **fbgrac@gmail.com**, após isso enviar comprovante para o mesmo e-mail, contendo o print do comprovante e o nome do competidor. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. **Caso o limite de 28 competidores não seja atingido, estaremos aceitando inscrições no local pelo preço de R$21, por ordem de chegada** ##English: **Competitors, heed the following warnings:** - This competition *will NOT have* the ***3x3x3*** event; - This competition will have a limit on competitors. Register only if you are **sure that you will participate**. In case of withdrawal, please **contact the organization**; - The competitor may register in advance on the website and their registration will only be confirmed upon payment of the fee via PIX: **fbgrac@gmail.com**, after which send proof of registration to the same email, containing the print of the proof of registration and the name of the competitor. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said in WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. **If the competitor limit of 28 isn't reached, we will be accepting on the spot registrations for the price of R$21, in order of arrival**

items.information: 🇧🇷 Estamos ansiosos para recebê-los e queremos compartilhar algumas dicas importantes para os competidores e acompanhantes: ​ - **Apesar de ser uma competição na praia, os competidores deverão estar adequadamente trajados. Não será permitida a participação de pessoas que utilizem trajes de banho.** - Sua inscrição será confirmada no site da WCA assim que o pagamento for confirmado e o comprovante for enviado. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcnlIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--332177ea99a8c8d5f8b82db10b1ac1f7c00234a9/io%20(1).png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al Ameca Nayarit 2025, la primera competencia oficial en el hermoso entorno costero y tropical de Nuevo Nayarit, y la segunda en el municipio de Bahía de Banderas! Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo los dias 18 y 19 de enero del 2025. A medida que el río fluye, también lo hará la emoción de ver a los competidores resolver el cubo Rubik con asombrosa rapidez. Prepárense para estas jornadas inolvidables llenas de ingenio y velocidad. Esta competencia es organizada por la comunidad de Vallarta Speed. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ###### English Welcome to the Ameca Nayarit 2025, the first official competition in the beautiful coastal and tropical environment of Nuevo Nayarit, and the second in the municipality of Bahía de Banderas! This exciting and fast-paced event will take place on January 18 and 19, 2025. As the river flows, so will the thrill of watching competitors solve the Rubik's Cube with astonishing speed. Get ready for these unforgettable days full of ingenuity and speed. This competition is organized by the Vallarta Speed community. This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

Competitors will be divided into 2 teams, and will work together to try and achieve as many points as possible. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYwNTgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--3aa05b1024ee2e9271b7b0bd5d799771742bd090/IZCALLI%201%202%203%20(2).png) #### BIENVENIDOS A LA PRIMER PARADA DE LA RUTA CUBERA 2025, IZCALLI CLÁSICO Después de 6 años México regresa a tener una ruta cubera, por 3 ciudadades alrededor del país, siendo la primera Cuautitlán Izcalli en el Estado de México, con nuestro querido torneo Clásico! Habrá sorpresas para todos aquellos que completen la Ruta Cubera 2025, así que no dejes que se te vaya la primer parada, prepara tus mejores 3x3 y 2x2, te esperamos en Izcalli!. Un agradecimiento especial a las FES-Cuautitlán UNAM por las facilidades y apoyo para realizar este evento, y al Team Izcalli por el compromiso para poderlo llevar a cabo. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el reglamento de la WCA antes de la competencia.[](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). #### WELCOME TO THE FIRST STOP OF THE CUBER ROUTE 2025, IZCALLI CLASICO After 6 years, Mexico returns to have a cuba route, through 3 cities around the country, the first being Cuautitlán Izcalli in the State of Mexico, with our beloved Classic tournament! There will be surprises for all those who complete the Cuber 2025 Route, so don't let the first stop pass you by, prepare your best 3x3 and 2x2, we are waiting for you in Izcalli! We thank the FES-Cuautitlán UNAM for the facilities and support to hold this event and to the izcalli team for the commitment to be able to carry it out. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the WCA regulations before the competition. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYyNjAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--664f7af1cb593a99c2c06ca90444fbfb49eff7db/LOGO%20CAMPEONATO.jpg)[](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYyNTgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--61d1447a942fc176de0673dc670e37b5a873f2ec/LOGO%20CAMPEONATO.jpg) # Português A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando o bom andamento da competição, **ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador** nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram previstos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos, você compete; no outro, deverá ajudar a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores **menores de 16 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável**. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. **COMPETIDORES NOVATOS** devem asssitir [a este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) para aprender como competir em uma competição oficial de Cubo Mágico. **Não haverá tutorial para competidores novatos no dia da competição** As inscrições custam R$ 35,00 (trinta e cinco reais) e se encerram no dia 22 de janeiro de 2025 às 23h59min (horário local). A sua inscrição só será aceita após o cumprimento de todas as etapas de inscrição (pagamento e envio do comprovante por e-mail, com todas as informações solicitadas). O pagamento da inscrição não dá direito a acompanhantes. Convidados e espectadores, inclusive os responsáveis por menores de 16 anos, devem pagar uma taxa de R$ 10,00 (dez reais) para poderem ingressar no evento, preferencialmente antecipadamente. O espaço comporta apenas 35 acompanhantes no total, de modo que reservamos 1 acompanhante por competidor. Caso você queira levar mais de 1 acompanhante, sugerimos garantir vaga do 1o acompanhante e colocar os demais na lista de espera. Ao término das inscrições, entraremos em contato informando caso sobrem vagas de acompanhantes, para que você exerça a opção de levar mais. Inscrições no local serão aceitas no valor de R$ 45,00 (quarenta e cinco reais), caso haja vagas. Acompanhantes e espectadores poderão comprar seu ingresso no dia pelo valor de R$ 20,00 (vinte reais), caso haja vagas. **Modalidade não-oficial:** Este campeonato contará com uma modalidade extra e inovadora: Skewb OH (com uma mão) # English Registration is open to any person, from any country. To ensure the smooth running of the competition, **by registering for an event, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler** in that event (as provided by the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming overwhelming for just a few. Each event will have at least two groups for each event. In one of the groups, you compete; in the other you should help to scramble or as a judge. **ATTENTION:** Competitors **under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian**. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children. **FIRST TIME COMPETITORS** must watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) In order to learn how to compete in an official Rubik's Cube competition. **No tutorial for newcomers will occur at the competition** Registration costs R$35.00 (thirty five Brazilian reais) and close on January 22, 2025 at 23:59 (local time). Your registration will only be accepted once all the registration steps have been completed (payment and sending of proof) by e-mail, with all the information required). Payment of registration fee does not guarantee the competitor a companion. Guests and spectators, including the guardians of people under 16, must pay a fee of R$10.00 to enter the event, preferably in advance. The space can only hold 35 companions in total, so we reserve 1 companion per competitor. If you would like to bring more than 1 companion, we suggest that you secure a place for the 1st companion and put the others on the waiting list. At the end of registration, we'll contact you to let you know if there are any places left, so that you can choose to bring more. On-site registrations will be accepted for R$45.00 (fourty five Brazilian reais), if there are still places. Guests and spectators can buy their tickets on the day for R$20.00 (twenty Brazilian reais), if there are still places. **Unofficial Event:** This competition will count with an extra and innovative event: Skewb OH (one-handed)

items.name: Wellington Mind Games 2025
items.information: Wellington Mind Games 2025 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. It is focused on some of the more mentally demanding events, that are given less of a focus in normal competitions - blindfolded and fewest moves solving, specifically. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience or skill. There will also be event-based time limits in place, to ensure we stay on schedule, especially given the time taken by fewest moves solving. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. **The main event of this competition is Fewest Moves**

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ ### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist. ### After registration, please check your name on the [competitor list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/56/competitors). Please check the [wait list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/56/waitlist) if your name is not on the competitor list. ### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTQ1NTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c770014c6db789e76c32778326e0f6980f437a47/466472712_1925266651296844_7482586112726949324_n.jpg) Το Trikala Open 2025 θα είναι o πρωτος επίσημος διαγωνισμός της Ελλάδας για το 2025 στην πανέμορφη και υπερσύγχρονη πόλη των Τρικάλων! Στο αμφιθεατρικά χτισμένο ξενοδοχείο Ananti Resort & Spa, σε αίθουσα με πανοραμική θέα στην πόλη, θα διαγωνιστούν για 2 μέρες παλιοί και νέοι, μικροί και μεγάλοι Cubers απ´ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μια ακόμα γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε έτοιμοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) The Trikala Open 2025 will be the first official competition in Greece for 2025, held in the beautiful and ultra-modern city of Trikala! At the amphitheatrically built Ananti Resort & Spa, in a hall with panoramic views of the city, Cubers of all ages and skill levels, both newcomers and veterans, from across the country and beyond, will compete for two days. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and join us for yet another celebration of cubing! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: ### WCAシリーズ大会 「Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025/Tokyo Open PM WInter 2025/Tokyo Open FMC Winter 2025」はWCAシリーズ大会です。 WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち**一つにのみ**参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 このページは「Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025」のページです。 ・ [Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenAMWinter2025/)(**このページでは「AM大会」と表記**) ・ [Tokyo Open PM WInter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenPMWinter2025/)(**このページでは「PM大会」と表記**) ・ [Tokyo Open FMC WInter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenFMCWInter2025/)(**このページでは「FMC大会」と表記**) 各大会の種目、ラウンド数、開場時刻、定員は以下の通りです。 ・AM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 2ラウンド、開場時刻 9:10 定員56名 ・PM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 2ラウンド、開場時刻 13:00 定員56名 ・FMC大会：3x3x3 最小手数 1ラウンド、開場時刻 9:45 定員30名 ### 当日の来場時刻 AM大会については、**必ず**受付時間内の9:10から9:30の間にお越しください。 PM大会については、開場時刻の13:00までは会場に入れません。**必ず**13:00から13:20の間にお越しください。 FMC大会については、開場時刻の9:45までは会場に入れません。**必ず**9:45から10:15の間にお越しください。 AM大会は9:20から、PM大会は13:20から競技・ジャッジ・ランナーのレクチャーを行います。スピードキュービングの競技やジャッジ、ランナーを初めてなされる方は競技・ジャッジ・ランナーのレクチャーにご参加ください。 ※会場は他のイベントでも使用されている為、**会場前の廊下など建物内での待機はできません。** ### 参加費の支払い方法 参加費は受付時にお支払いください。 支払い方法は現金のみです。 ### 競技者以外のご入場 会場定員の都合上、入場者の数を制限させていただいています。 見学者（競技の観戦だけをされる方）の入場は会場定員の都合上、受け付けていません。 競技者が未成年者や身体的サポートが必要な方の場合、会場までの移動のサポート及び会場での安全の確保のため**保護者・サポート者の方1名**まで同伴していただくことは可能です。競技者が成人の方で身体的サポートの必要がない場合は、同伴者（ご友人など）のご入場はできません。 なお後日、当日スタッフを募集する可能性があります。当日スタッフとして登録されたかたはご入場していただくことは可能です。 ### ジャッジ・スクランブラー等の役割分担 WCA大会では、ご自身の競技参加のほか、他者の競技スタッフとしてジャッジやスクランブラ―をはじめとした役割が割り振られます。個人ごとの役割分担表は参加申し込み締め切り後にお伝えします。 競技参加者が年少者の場合など、自身での担当が困難なときには保護者などに代理でご協力いただくことがあります。具体的な作業の流れを確認する時間を大会当日に設けますので、不慣れな方は必ずご参加ください。 関連競技規則[1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/japanese/#1e2)および 競技規則[1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/japanese/#1f2) ★日本語が固まってから英語を修正 ### WCA Series Competitions Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025/Tokyo Open PM WInter 2025/Tokyo Open FMC Winter 2025 are recongnized as WCA series competitions. WCA series competitions are a series of multiple competitions. You can participate in **only one** of them. If you register for more than one competition in a series, only the earliest registration will be valid, and the others will be invalid. This page is for Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025. [Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenAMWinter2025/) (**In this page, called "AM"**) [Tokyo Open PM WInter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenPMWinter2025/) (**In this page, called "PM"**) [Tokyo Open FMC Winter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenFMCWinter2025/) (**In this page, called "FMC"**) The events, number of rounds, opening time, and maximum number of players for each event are as follows: AM : 3x3x3 Cube 2 rounds, open at 9:10, limit of competitors 56 PM : 3x3x3 Cube 2 rounds, open at 13:00, limit of competitors 56 FMC：3x3x3 Fewest Moves 1 round, open at 9:45, limit of competitors 30 ### Arrival Information For the AM competition, **please be sure to arrive for check-in between 9:10 and 9:30.** For the PM competition, **please be sure to arrive for check-in between 13:00 and 13:20.** Competitors won't be allowed to enter until 13:00. For the FMC competition, **please be sure to arrive for check-in between 9:45 and 10:15.** *Judge and runner lecture will be held at 9:20 for AM and 13:20 for PM. If this is your first time assigned as a judge or runner, please join the lecture session. *The hallway is shared with other events/business. Please do not stay in the building hallway before check-in. ### How to pay the participation fee Please pay the participation fee at check-in. Payment must be made in cash only. ### Limit of non-competitor Guest We apply guest limitaion due to the venue capacity. We do not accept spectors. Underage competitors or those who has accessibility needs may **bring up to one non-competitor guest.** Adults and those who do not have accessibilty needs please refrain from bringing guests into the venue. We may request volunteer staffs for the competition in a later day. Those who are selected to be staffs will be accepted to enter the venue. ### The roles of judges and scramblers According to regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors must be prepared to perform duties as judges, scramblers and other roles required. For younger competitors or those unable to fulfill these roles, we may ask parents or guardians to assist on their behalf. Staff procedures will be lectured at the venue.

items.information: ### WCAシリーズ大会 「Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025/Tokyo Open PM WInter 2025/Tokyo Open FMC Winter 2025」はWCAシリーズ大会です。 WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち**一つにのみ**参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 このページは「Tokyo Open FMC Winter 2025」のページです。 ・ [Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenAMWinter2025/)(**このページでは「AM大会」と表記**) ・ [Tokyo Open PM WInter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenPMWinter2025/)(**このページでは「PM大会」と表記**) ・ [Tokyo Open FMC WInter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenFMCWInter2025/)(**このページでは「FMC大会」と表記**) 各大会の種目、ラウンド数、開場時刻、定員は以下の通りです。 ・AM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 2ラウンド、開場時刻 9:10 定員56名 ・PM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 2ラウンド、開場時刻 13:00 定員56名 ・FMC大会：3x3x3 最小手数 1ラウンド、開場時刻 9:45 定員30名 ### 当日の来場時刻 AM大会については、**必ず**受付時間内の9:10から9:30の間にお越しください。 PM大会については、開場時刻の13:00までは会場に入れません。**必ず**13:00から13:20の間にお越しください。 FMC大会については、開場時刻の9:45までは会場に入れません。**必ず**9:45から10:15の間にお越しください。 AM大会は9:20から、PM大会は13:20から競技・ジャッジ・ランナーのレクチャーを行います。スピードキュービングの競技やジャッジ、ランナーを初めてなされる方は競技・ジャッジ・ランナーのレクチャーにご参加ください。 ※会場は他のイベントでも使用されている為、**会場前の廊下など建物内での待機はできません。** ### 参加費の支払い方法 参加費は受付時にお支払いください。 支払い方法は現金のみです。 ### 競技者以外のご入場 会場定員の都合上、入場者の数を制限させていただいています。 見学者（競技の観戦だけをされる方）の入場は会場定員の都合上、受け付けていません。 競技者が未成年者や身体的サポートが必要な方の場合、会場までの移動のサポート及び会場での安全の確保のため**保護者・サポート者の方1名**まで同伴していただくことは可能です。競技者が成人の方で身体的サポートの必要がない場合は、同伴者（ご友人など）のご入場はできません。 なお後日、当日スタッフを募集する可能性があります。当日スタッフとして登録されたかたはご入場していただくことは可能です。 ### ジャッジ・スクランブラー等の役割分担 WCA大会では、ご自身の競技参加のほか、他者の競技スタッフとしてジャッジやスクランブラ―をはじめとした役割が割り振られます。個人ごとの役割分担表は参加申し込み締め切り後にお伝えします。 競技参加者が年少者の場合など、自身での担当が困難なときには保護者などに代理でご協力いただくことがあります。具体的な作業の流れを確認する時間を大会当日に設けますので、不慣れな方は必ずご参加ください。 関連競技規則[1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/japanese/#1e2)および 競技規則[1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/japanese/#1f2) ★日本語が固まってから英語を修正 ### WCA Series Competitions Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025/Tokyo Open PM WInter 2025/Tokyo Open FMC Winter 2025 are recongnized as WCA series competitions. WCA series competitions are a series of multiple competitions. You can participate in **only one** of them. If you register for more than one competition in a series, only the earliest registration will be valid, and the others will be invalid. This page is for Tokyo Opne FMC Winter 2025. [Tokyo Open AM Winter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenAMWinter2025/) (**In this page, called "AM"**) [Tokyo Open PM WInter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenPMWinter2025/) (**In this page, called "PM"**) [Tokyo Open FMC Winter 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoOpenFMCWinter2025/) (**In this page, called "FMC"**) The events, number of rounds, opening time, and maximum number of players for each event are as follows: AM : 3x3x3 Cube 2 rounds, open at 9:10, limit of competitors 56 PM : 3x3x3 Cube 2 rounds, open at 13:00, limit of competitors 56 FMC：3x3x3 Fewest Moves 1 round, open at 9:45, limit of competitors 30 ### Arrival Information For the AM competition, **please be sure to arrive for check-in between 9:10 and 9:30.** For the PM competition, **please be sure to arrive for check-in between 13:00 and 13:20.** Competitors won't be allowed to enter until 13:00. For the FMC competition, **please be sure to arrive for check-in between 9:45 and 10:15.** *Judge and runner lecture will be held at 9:20 for AM and 13:20 for PM. If this is your first time assigned as a judge or runner, please join the lecture session. *The hallway is shared with other events/business. Please do not stay in the building hallway before check-in. . ### How to pay the participation fee Please pay the participation fee at check-in. Payment must be made in cash only. ### Limit of non-competitor Guest We apply guest limitaion due to the venue capacity. We do not accept spectors. Underage competitors or those who has accessibility needs may **bring up to one non-competitor guest.** Adults and those who do not have accessibilty needs please refrain from bringing guests into the venue. We may request volunteer staffs for the competition in a later day. Those who are selected to be staffs will be accepted to enter the venue. ### The roles of judges and scramblers According to regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors must be prepared to perform duties as judges, scramblers and other roles required. For younger competitors or those unable to fulfill these roles, we may ask parents or guardians to assist on their behalf. Staff procedures will be lectured at the venue.

Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience (or participation earlier in the league). items.information: This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) Get ready for a day of big cubes and blindfolded solving in San Jose! # This competition does NOT have 3x3x3 Cube. If you'd like to compete in 3x3, see [Bay Area Side Events Day 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BayAreaSideEventsDay2025). All attendees are required to be quiet during blindfolded events, as these events require lots of concentration. If you would like to talk during a blindfolded event, please step outside of the venue first. **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Lunch will end at the scheduled time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. If you're interested in unofficial events, check out [Bay Area Side Events Day 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BayAreaSideEventsDay2025), a competition in San Jose on the same weekend!

items.information: (HR) Osijek Open 2025 je natjecanje koje se već tradicionalno održava krajem zime u Osijeku. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost, no svatko mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom. Natjecanje je pod organizacijom Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije i najma prostora. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Za više informacija, proučite ostale kartice na stranici natjecanja. ---- (EN) Osijek Open 2025 is a competition that is traditionally held near the end of winter in Osijek. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations. This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the organization and venue rental. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia. For more information, check other tabs on the competition website.

items.information: #### **This is a very beginner-friendly competition! All are welcome but if you have never competed before this is the one to sign up for!** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjUwMzMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--2d81b584eaed41b3bca38d74ac30447709a1944e/NCM%202025%20A1.png) This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. ##### The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. There will be special prizes to honour first-timer cubers! Registrations will be accepted based on the following: 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. * Make sure you will be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. You WILL NOT be allowed to participate in an event if you reach late for the same. We urge all the competitors to strictly adhere to the rules and regulations to contribute to the mission of providing a comfortable ambience for all the fellow cubers. If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, make sure that you attend the tutorial session. Please bring your ID card as well. Happy cubing!

items.name: German Newcomer Day 2025
items.information: **English** **This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025.** The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. **Registrations will be accepted based on the following:** * 50% of spots (60 spots) are initially reserved for new competitors. * 50% of spots (60 spots) are initially are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If more than 60 new competitors register before 60 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the 60 spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Deutsch** **Dieser Wettbewerb ist Teil des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month 2025.** Bei der Anmeldung werden 50% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmer gelten Teilnehmer ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2025. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmer haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2024 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmer müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. **Anmeldungen werden nach folgenden Kriterien angenommen:** * 50% der Plätze (60 Plätze) sind zunächst für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. * 50% der Plätze (60 Plätze) sind zunächst für wiederkehrende Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" verfügbar. * Wenn sich mehr als 60 neue Teilnehmer anmelden, bevor die 60 Plätze von den zurückgekehrten Teilnehmern besetzt sind, werden alle weiteren neuen Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" zusammen mit den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugelassen. * Wenn die 60 für neue Teilnehmer reservierten Plätze zwei Wochen vor dem Wettbewerb nicht durch neue Teilnehmer besetzt sind, werden die verbleibenden Plätze bis zum Teilnehmerlimit den bereits registrierten Teilnehmern zugewiesen.

items.name: Romandie Rookies 2025
items.information: ### WCA Newcomer Month ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjAzODksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9f4703bb8694974000e48f846fd2d76ffa28f318/newcomer.jpg) [FR] C'est une compétition très accessible pour les débutants ! Tout le monde est le bienvenu mais si vous n'avez jamais participé à une compétition auparavant, c'est celle à laquelle vous devez vous inscrire ! Cette compétition fait partie du mois officiel des débutants WCA 2025. Le processus d'inscription réservera 50 % des places pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Les nouveaux compétiteurs sont considérés comme n'ayant pas d'ID WCA ou ayant un ID WCA datant de 2025. Les anciens compétiteurs sont considérés comme ayant un ID WCA datant d'avant 2024. Les inscriptions seront acceptées selon les critères suivants : 50 % des places sont réservées aux nouveaux compétiteurs, et l'autre moitié est disponible pour les autres compétiteurs, selon le principe du premier arrivé, premier servi. Si les nouveaux compétiteurs s'inscrivent rapidement et remplissent plus de 50 % des places, les autres nouveaux compétiteurs seront acceptés en même temps que les anciens. Si les places réservées aux nouveaux compétiteurs ne sont pas toutes prises avant la clôture des inscriptions (deux semaines avant la compétition), les places restantes seront ouvertes pour tous. Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec Romandie Doigts Rapides 2025. Vous ne pouvez vous inscrire et participer qu'à l'une de ces compétitions. [EN] This is a very beginner-friendly competition! Everyone is welcome but if you have never competed before this is the one to sign up for! This competition is part of the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID from 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. This competition is a series competition with Romandie Doigtes Rapides 2025. You may only register for and compete in one of these competitions.

items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## Sponsorship ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjY5MTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--043850cb450564025444969edb4c94d522019cb1/image.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** will have discounted rates for accommodation for those wanting to overnight at the hotel during the weekend of the competition. Be sure to keep a lookout for more information in this regard. Their restaurant will also be open for meals and refreshments during the competition. Please see the Legacy Centurion Hotel tab for more information. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## NOTICE OF FILMING Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYwMTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--590d632186b67d440422c5a58d28b228cf84e84a/%E1%84%89%E1%85%B3%E1%84%8F%E1%85%B3%E1%84%85%E1%85%B5%E1%86%AB%E1%84%89%E1%85%A3%E1%86%BA%202024-12-25%2000.10.29.png) 이 대회는 WCA Newcomer Month 2025의 일환입니다. 참가자 정원의 50%는 첫 참가자에게 배정됩니다. 이 때 첫 참가자란, WCA ID가 없거나 WCA ID가 2025로 시작하는 분들입니다. 기존 참가자(첫 참가자가 아닌 분)는 WCA ID가 2024 또는 그 이전의 숫자로 시작하는 분들입니다. 모든 참가자는 모든 등록 요건을 충족해야 등록이 완료된 것으로 간주됩니다. 참가 신청은 다음 사항을 기준으로 수락됩니다: - 참가자 정원의 50%는 첫 참가자에게 배정됩니다. - 나머지 50%는 기존 참가자에게 배정됩니다. - 기존 참가자가 정원의 50%를 채우기 전에 첫 참가자가 정원의 50% 이상 등록하면, 배정된 50% 안에 선착순에 의해 들지 못한 첫 참가자는 기존 참가자와 구분 없이 선착순으로 수락됩니다. - 첫 참가자를 위한 자리가 대회 시작 2주 전 또는 참가 신청 기간 마감일이 되기 전에 모두 채워지지 않으면, 남은 자리는 기존 참가자들로부터 선착순으로 수락됩니다. --- This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: - 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. - Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. - If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. - If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. --- 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오. --- Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYwMTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--590d632186b67d440422c5a58d28b228cf84e84a/%E1%84%89%E1%85%B3%E1%84%8F%E1%85%B3%E1%84%85%E1%85%B5%E1%86%AB%E1%84%89%E1%85%A3%E1%86%BA%202024-12-25%2000.10.29.png) 이 대회는 WCA Newcomer Month 2025의 일환입니다. 참가자 정원의 50%는 첫 참가자에게 배정됩니다. 이 때 첫 참가자란, WCA ID가 없거나 WCA ID가 2025로 시작하는 분들입니다. 기존 참가자(첫 참가자가 아닌 분)는 WCA ID가 2024 또는 그 이전의 숫자로 시작하는 분들입니다. 모든 참가자는 모든 등록 요건을 충족해야 등록이 완료된 것으로 간주됩니다. 참가 신청은 다음 사항을 기준으로 수락됩니다: - 참가자 정원의 50%는 첫 참가자에게 배정됩니다. - 나머지 50%는 기존 참가자에게 배정됩니다. - 기존 참가자가 정원의 50%를 채우기 전에 첫 참가자가 정원의 50% 이상 등록하면, 배정된 50% 안에 선착순에 의해 들지 못한 첫 참가자는 기존 참가자와 구분 없이 선착순으로 수락됩니다. - 첫 참가자를 위한 자리가 대회 시작 2주 전 또는 참가 신청 기간 마감일이 되기 전에 모두 채워지지 않으면, 남은 자리는 기존 참가자들로부터 선착순으로 수락됩니다. --- This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: - 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. - Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. - If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. - If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. --- 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오. --- Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

items.name: Let's Solve Liberec 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYzNTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--3108208eb7baaec4005983963bd4455293cbb240/1000049076.png) ### ČEŠTINA Tato soutěž se účastní oficiálního Měsíce nováčků WCA 2025. Při registraci bude 50 % míst vyhrazeno pro nováčky. Za nováčky se považují ti, kteří ještě na své první WCA soutěži nebyli, nebo na ní byli v roce 2025 (nemají WCA ID, nebo mají WCA ID s rokem 2025). Za vracející se soutěžící se považujeme ty, kteří mají WCA ID s rokem 2024 a méně. Všichni soutěžící musí i nadále dodržet všechny registrační požadavky, aby jejich registrace byla považována za kompletní. Registrace budou přijímány na základě následujících kritérií: * 50 % míst je vyhrazeno pro nové soutěžící. * Na zbylých 50 % míst budou přijati vracející se soutěžící podle pořadí přihlášení. * Po obsazení vyhrazené kapacity pro nováčky budou na zbývající místa přijímáni jak vracející se soutěžící, tak nováčci, podle pořadí přihlášení. * Nebude-li vyhrazená kapacita pro nováčky naplněna 2 týdny před začátkem soutěže, budou na tato místa přijímáni i vracející se soutěžící, dle pořadí registrace. #### **Pódium pro nováčky** S potěšením oznamujeme, že v kategorii 3x3x3 budeme vyhlašovat pódium pro nové soutěžící. ### ENGLISH This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50 % of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: * 50 % of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * Initially, 50 % of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If greater than 50 % of new competitors register before 50 % of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. #### **Newcomer podium** We are excited to announce that special podium awards will be presented to newcomers in the 3x3x3 event.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjM0NzgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--7f38aa440f2f5ea4ba0f22de16d4f6cdf4c47946/IMG-20250124-WA0034.jpg) ​ ##### Español ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ¡Bienvenidos a **Mega-Mente Puebla 2025**! Puebla se prepara para recibirte en un torneo que pondrá a prueba tus habilidades y conocimientos. **¿Qué tan lejos puede llegar tu mente?** El nombre del torneo y nuestra categoría principal no son coincidencia. Cada detalle ha sido pensado para resaltar la conexión entre la fuerza mental y el desafío que representa este evento. El Megaminx, con su forma dodecaédrica, representa un verdadero desafío para la mente, exigiendo combinar estrategia, eficiencia, precisión, visión espacial y velocidad. Así es como Megaminx se convierte en el corazón de este torneo, acompañado de otras categorías desafiantes que pondrán a prueba tu mente. Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**. Mega-Mente Puebla 2025 es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). ​ ##### English ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Welcome to **Mega-Mente Puebla 2025**! Puebla is ready to welcome you to a tournament that will challenge your knowledge and skills. **How far can your mind go?** The name of the tournament and our main category are no coincidence. Every detail has been carefully designed to highlight the connection between mental strength and the challenge this event represents. The Megaminx, with its dodecahedral shape, embodies a true mental challenge, demanding a combination of strategy, efficiency, precision, spatial awareness, and speed. This is why the Megaminx becomes the heart of this tournament, accompanied by other challenging categories that will put your mind to the test. This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**. Mega-Mind Puebla 2025 is an official WCA competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.name: Mental Breakdown Hoorn 2025
items.information: De derde Mental Breakdown competitie in Nederland! Op het programma staan de blind-onderdelen, FMC en big cubes. Een wedstrijd voor de fanatiekelingen dus. Het main event is 3x3x3 blindfolded. **Let op: Dit is een wedstrijd voor stille events en is niet geschikt voor nieuwkomers. Er zullen GEEN 3×3 of andere gebruikelijke events zijn, dus als je NIET geïnteresseerd bent in geblinddoekt oplossen of "big cubes", overweeg dan om je niet in te schrijven.** --- The third Mental Breakdown competition in the Netherlands! On the schedule you will find the blind events, FMC and big cubes. A competition for the real fanatic. The main event is 3x3x3 blindfolded. **NOTE: This is a competition for silent events and it is not suitable for newcomers. There will be NO 3x3 or other regular events, so if you are not interested in blindfolded solving or "big cubes" please consider not signing up.**

items.name: Newcomers Cape Cube-Fest 2025
items.information: Welcome to Newcomers Cape Cube-Fest 2025! This competition aims to bring new people into the speedcubing community, no matter your speed or experience level! Please see the **Newcomer Competitor's Tab** for more information. A huge thanks to [Speedcubes](www.speedcubes.co.za) for sponsoring this competition! Please see the Sponsors tab for more information, and make sure to support the Speedcubes shop at the competition. ![Speedcubes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5NDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--f899ecbbd498c3dd38ea30276772dcc02470011a/NEW_SPEEDCUBE_LOGO_BLACK.webp) ### IMPORTANT - Cape Town Cycle Tour Road Closures Sunday, 9 March is the **Cape Town Cycle Tour**, which means many roads will be closed throughout the day of the competition. Please ensure you have made travel arrangements to get around these closures. If you stay in an area that is going to be completely cut off due to the road closures, please make accommodation arrangements to stay with someone closer to the venue on Saturday night/Sunday morning so that you can make it to the competition! **No refunds** can be issued if you discover on the day of the competition that you cannot make it to the venue due to road closures. Please plan accordingly. _____________

The registration process will reserve 30% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: ● 30% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. ● Initially, 70% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. ● If greater than 30% of new competitors register before 70% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. ● If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

Come enjoy all the NxN categories and dive into the excitement of the silent events. Baja Cubing and the Museum of the Spinning Top are joining forces to take speedcubing to the next level in Baja California! It will be an epic event that will make history, full of adrenaline, speed, and tons of fun! See you at Baja Spring 2025! items.name: Drop-in Cubing Partille 2025
items.information: Välkomna till Drop-in Cubing Partille 2025! Detta är en speciell tävling som hålls under Pussel-SM, där deltagarna bjuds in att lära sig lösa kuben och testa på att tävla. Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. **OBS**: Tävlingen är i en serie med Kungkuben 2025 som pågår samtidigt. Detta betyder att det inte är tillåtet att tävla i båda tävlingarna. ----- Welcome to Drop-in Cubing Partille 2025! This is a special competition held during the Swedish Jigsaw Puzzle Championship, where participants are invited to learn how to solve the cube and try competing for the first time. Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. **Note**: This competition is part of a series with Kungkuben 2025. This means that it is not allowed to compete in both competitions. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.name: FMC French Championship 2025
items.information: Merci de **lire attentivement les conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](#48026-faq) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule). **ATTENTION** Cette compétition n'est PAS une compétition classique. Il n'y aura qu'une seule épreuve : la résolution optimisée (Fewest Moves), pendant laquelle la solution la plus courte à un mélange donné doit être trouvée et écrite sur une feuille en un temps maximum d'une heure. **Il n'y aura pas de 3x3 classique lors de cette compétition.** ---- Please **read the registration conditions, the [FAQ](#48026-faq) et the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**. Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab. **WARNING** This competition is NOT a regular competition. There will be only one event: Fewest Moves, in which the shortest solution to a given scramble must be found and written on a sheet of paper in a maximum of one hour. **There will be no 3x3 in this competition.**

Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: - 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. - If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. - If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Kindly read through all tabs on this page as they contain very useful information.** All competitors are advised to review the information provided in the ["**Updates & Announcements**"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysiaNewComer2025#54278-updates-announcements). Competitors should ***ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date***, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information. ***Our schedule, cutoff & time limit is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.***

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzg2NjgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--4a307f5a3abfaeb595f55866303bedaa9e09572c/NCM%202025%20A1.png) ## Mississauga 3x3x3 Newcomers Series One day, two competitions! We are running this one-day competition series as part of **WCA Newcomer Month**. 40% of spots will be reserved for newcomers (see **WCA Newcomer Month 2025** near the bottom of this page for more information). You can choose between [Mississauga 3x3x3 Newcomers A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MississaugaNewcomersA2025) and [Mississauga 3x3x3 Newcomers B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MississaugaNewcomersB2025)! These competitions are identical except for the time of day they take place (morning or afternoon). You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** This is a great opportunity for newcomers to compete in 3x3x3 Cube – the maximum-allowed top-75% of competitors will advance to the second round! Plus, as part of WCA Newcomer Month we will have special prizes and initiatives for first-time competitors. ### Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Rahn Education Open 2025
items.information: **Deutsch** Herzlich Willkommen zur **Rahn Education Open 2025** in Leipzig Nach den ersten beiden Competitions 2023 und 2024 sowie den Rubik's German Nationals 2024 können wir **Leipzig** nun zu einem etablierten Cubing-Standort zählen. Wir, das Orga-Team, freuen uns auf euer zahlreiches Erscheinen. Euch erwartet wieder eine schöne Venue in perfekter zentraler Lage in Leipzig, ein motiviertes Orga-Team und vieles mehr. Diese Ausgabe der **Rahn Education Open** im Rahmen des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month richtet sich an neue und unerfahrene Cuber. Bei der Anmeldung werden deshalb 43,75% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmende reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmende gelten Teilnehmende ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2025. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmende haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2024 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmenden müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. Weitere Informationen zur Annahme der Anmeldungen findet ihr im Tab "Newcomer Month". **Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.** **English** Welcome to the **Rahn Education Open 2025** in Leipzig After the first two competitions in 2023 and 2024 and the Rubik's German Nationals 2024, we can now count **Leipzig** as an established cubing location. We, the organizing team, are looking forward to your numerous appearances. Once again, you can expect a beautiful venue in a perfect central location in Leipzig, a motivated organizing team and much more. This edition of the **Rahn Education Open** as part of the official WCA Newcomer Month is aimed at new and inexperienced cubers. When registering, 43.75% of the places will therefore be reserved for new participants. Participants without a WCA ID or with a WCA ID from the year 2025 are considered new participants. Returning participants have a WCA ID from the year 2024 or earlier. All participants must continue to fulfill all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. You can find more information on how registrations are accepted in the “Newcomer Month” tab. **Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjAzODksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9f4703bb8694974000e48f846fd2d76ffa28f318/newcomer.jpg) **Deutsch** Die "WWiler Newcomer 2025" im Rahmen des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month richtet sich insbesondere an neue und unerfahrene Cuber. Sie ist ausserdem Partner-Competition vom "Wiler Würfelfäst 2025". Bitte beachte, dass du nur an einem der beiden Wettbewerbe teilnehmen kannst. Wenn du dich für beide Wettbewerbe anmeldest, so zählt nur die erste Anmeldung und wir werden die zweite (spätere) Anmeldung unverzüglich löschen. Bei der Anmeldung werden 50% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmende reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmende gelten Teilnehmer:innen ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2025. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmende haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2024 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmenden müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. Weitere Informationen zur Annahme der Anmeldungen findet ihr im Tab "Newcomer Month". **English** This edition "Wiler Newcomer 2025" is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month and is especially directed towards new and inexperienced competitors. It is also a partner competition of the "Wiler Würfelfäst 2025". Please note that you can only compete in one of the two competitions. If you register for both competitions, only the first registration will be valid and we will immediately delete the second (later) registration. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Further information on the acceptance of registrations can be found in the tab "Newcomer Month".

Prijave će se primati uobičajenim redoslijedom po principu "tko prvi, njegovo". * Ako se više od 50% novih natjecatelja prijavi prije nego što se preostalih 50% mjesta popuni povratnicima, daljnje prijave se prihvaćaju uobičajenim redoslijedom za nove natjecatelje i povratnike u isto vrijeme. * Ako mjesta osigurana za nove natjecatelje ne popune novi natjecatelji dva tjedna prije zatvaranja registracija, preostala mjesta, do ograničenja natjecatelja, bit će prihvaćena od registriranih povratnika. items.name: CubeCo Coastal Cubing KZN 2025
items.information: **Durban’s First 2-Day Cubing Competition in Over Two Years!** Join us for an action-packed weekend of speedcubing on March 21st & 22nd! Day 1 (Friday) falls on Human Rights Day, making it the perfect opportunity to challenge yourself with events you don't always see - like Clock, Megaminx, and even 3x3 Blindfolded! If you're looking to try something new, this is your chance. Day 2 (Saturday) is all about the fan favorites: Pyraminx, 2x2, and a full three rounds of 3x3. Whether you're a seasoned competitor or brand new to WCA events, there's something for you. New to competing? No problem! We'll have a newcomer tutorial to walk you through competing and judging (yes, even first-timers help with judging). Just remember to bring a form of ID for registration. While most beginner-friendly events happen on Saturday, you're absolutely welcome to compete on Friday too! Don't miss out - come test your skills, meet fellow cubers, and be part of Durban's cubing community!
