items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjAzODksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9f4703bb8694974000e48f846fd2d76ffa28f318/newcomer.jpg) [IT] Si tratta di una gara adatta ai principianti! Tutti sono i benvenuti, ma se non avete mai gareggiato prima d'ora, questa è la gara a cui iscriversi! Questa gara fa parte del WCA Newcomer Month 2025. Il processo di iscrizione riserverà il 50% dei posti ai nuovi concorrenti. Per nuovi concorrenti si intende che non hanno un ID WCA o un ID WCA del 2025. I concorrenti che ritornano sono considerati in possesso di un ID WCA del 2024 o precedente. Tutti i concorrenti devono comunque rispettare tutti i requisiti di registrazione affinché la loro iscrizione sia considerata completa. Le iscrizioni saranno accettate in base a quanto segue: Il 50% dei posti, come definito dal limite dei concorrenti, è riservato ai nuovi concorrenti. Inizialmente, il 50% dei posti, come definito dal limite dei concorrenti, è disponibile per i concorrenti che ritornano, in base all'ordine di arrivo. Se più del 50% dei nuovi concorrenti si iscrive prima che il 50% dei posti sia occupato dai concorrenti che ritornano, ogni ulteriore nuovo concorrente sarà accettato in base all'ordine di arrivo, insieme ai concorrenti che ritornano. Se i posti riservati ai nuovi concorrenti non vengono occupati da nuovi concorrenti prima della chiusura delle iscrizioni due settimane prima della gara, i posti rimanenti, fino al limite dei concorrenti, saranno accettati dai concorrenti già iscritti. Questa gara è una competizione in serie con **Show Your Skills in Ponte Tresa 2025**. È possibile iscriversi e partecipare a una sola di queste gare. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. This competition is a series competition with **Show Your Skills in Ponte Tresa 2025**. You may only register for and compete in one of these competitions.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdUplIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--92701aef7af516be4361993a7c4150fa9e22ea2d/image.png) # This competition features easy and popular events, making it perfect for newcomers. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjA3NzIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--1ce2d0d5715009d578d2d8e7e5719e7d7b032738/newcomers2025.png) **First Time Competitors:** All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY&ab_channel=SpeedcubingCanada) for a basic rundown of a competition. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: * 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Judging:** All competitors are expected to help at this competition. We will have a judging tutorial at the beginning of the day. All competitors will be assigned to judge 1 group of each of the events they are competing in. There will also be draw prizes throughout the day to encourage competitors to stay after their round is done. **Mystery event:** There will be a mystery event at lunch. You only need to know how to solve a 3x3 to participate. **4x4** There will be no cutoff for 4x4 at this competition. The cumulative time limit is 20 minutes. You may take over 10 minutes to do a single solve if you let your judge know beforehand. 4x4 is scheduled such that overflow into lunch is acceptable so everyone can get results. --- We ask attendees to limit themselves to one guest per competitor if possible so that we do not go over capacity limits for this venue which is 160 people. Attendance is not required for the entire competition, however please arrive at least 15 minutes before your event's planned start time. Please bring your own cubes for the events you are competing in. Notice of Filming and Photography: Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Nach einem erfolgreichem Fasching Turnier im letzten Jahr, dürfen wir auch dieses Jahr wieder Vienna Fasching 2025 als offizelles WCA Turnier ankündigen. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Dinh und Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan und Florian Truckenthanner. Diesmal findet die Competition im Jugendgästehaus Brigittenau statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** After a successful Fasching Competition last year, we are once again happy to announce Vienna Fasching 2024 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by David Dinh and Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan and Florian Truckenthanner. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjQ3NzUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b83885f0ca3e638334b1142605be9fcc75373ce5/newcm.png) (SRB) **Irig Newcommer Day 2025** je dvadeset i četvrto po redu takmičenje koje se održava u Srbiji. Svako može da se takmiči, nezavisno od njihove nacionalnosti ili godina, ali moraju biti upoznati sa WCA Regulacijama i moraju da ih pročitaju pre takmičenja. Ovo takmičenje učestvuje u zvaničnom **WCA Mesecu Novih Takmičara 2025**. Proces registracije obezbeđuje 50% mesta za nove takmičare. Novi takmičari su oni koji još nemaju WCA ID ili imaju WCA ID iz 2025. godine. Takmičari koji imaju WCA ID iz 2024. godine ili ranije smatraju se povratnicima. Svi takmičari i dalje moraju ispuniti sve zahteve za prijavu kako bi njihova prijava bila smatrana potpunom. **Prijave će se prihvatati na sledeći način:** * 50% mesta, određenih ograničenjem broja takmičara, obezbeđeno je za nove takmičare. * Ako se više od 50% novih takmičara prijavi pre nego što se preostalih 50% mesta popuni povratnicima, dalja prijava će se prihvatati uobičajenim redosledom za nove takmičare i povratnike istovremeno. * Ako mesta obezbeđena za nove takmičare ne popune novi takmičari dve nedelje pre zatvaranja registracija, preostala mesta, do ograničenja broja takmičara, biće dodeljena prijavljenim povratnicima. ------------------------ (ENG) **Irig Newcommer Day 2025** is the 24th speedcubing competition in a row that's being held in Serbia. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and read them before the competition. This competition is participating in the official **WCA Newcomer Month 2025**. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. **Registrations will be accepted based on the following:** * 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks before registration closes, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

Мы настоятельно рекомендуем использовать на головоломках отличительные отметки (Внутри кубика или под крышкой детальки) , по которым их легко может идентифицировать владелец. После оплаты взноса ваша фамилия появится на сайте. Это означает, что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1 неделю до и непосредственно перед закрытием регистрации вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и папку СПАМ. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. Если Вы подали заявку и оплатили взнос, но в течении 2-х рабочих дней ее не подтвердили, сразу обратитесь к организаторам (не считая выходные дни). ##### В день соревнований участнику при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность. --- Біздің Instagram парақшамызды қараңыз (https://www.instagram.com/cubing.kz?igsh=MTlycGkxYnd5MnF6aA==). Төлемді төлегеннен кейін сіздің аты-жөніңіз сайтта пайда болады. Бұл сіздің өтінішіңіз қабылданғанын білдіреді. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемеген болсаңыз, онда тіркеуден шамамен 1 апта бұрын және тіркеуді жаппас бұрын, сіз өзіңіздің қатысуыңызды растау үшін жарнаны төлеу қажеттілігі туралы ескерту хат аласыз. Міндетті түрде Жәшік пен СПАМ қалтасын тексеріңіз. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемесеңіз, онда сіздің өтініміңіз қабылданбайды. Егер сіз өтінім беріп, жарнаны төлеген болсаңыз, бірақ оны 2 жұмыс күні ішінде растамаған болса, дереу Ұйымдастырушыларға хабарласыңыз (демалыс күндерін есептемегенде). ​ ##### Жарыс күні қатысушыда өзімен бірге жеке басын куәландыратын құжат болуы қажет. --- Please see our Instagram account (https://www.instagram.com/cubing.kz?igsh=MTlycGkxYnd5MnF6aA==). All information and news on the competition will be on our instagram. The organizers are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings. We strongly recommend using distinctive marks on the puzzles (Inside the cube or under the cover of the part), by which the owner can easily identify them. After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site. This means that your application has been accepted. If you have not paid the fee, you will receive an email reminding you to pay the fee to confirm your participation approximately 1 week before and immediately before the registration closes. Be sure to check your inbox and SPAM folder. If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be accepted. If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but did not confirm it within 2 working days, immediately contact the organizers (excluding weekends). ##### On the day of the competition, the participant must have an identity document with him.

To register, use the WCA website and follow the payment details **if you are a returning competitor**. **If you are a newcomer**, please contact Xavier De Vera at 09461564040 for the details. Payment Method: Slots are secured via payment-first system. You may pay for your registration fees via: **GCash Express Send** Account Name: Xavier De Vera Account Number: 0946 156 4040 ** PLEASE indicate the NAME OF THE COMPETITOR in message/note tab in GCash app before sending payment. items.information: **PORTUGUÊS** Sejam todos bem-vindos à segunda competição no Alto da XV Mall em parceria com o Capivara! Essa competição terá como foco os "big cubes", portanto teremos tempos de corte generosos para que todos possam participar e se divertir. Também teremos premiação extra-oficial para as mulheres e os iniciantes melhores colocados na modalidade 3x3x3. Nesta competição estamos arrecadando doações para fins filantrópicos, assim, além de nos divertirmos, também ajudamos a fazer um mundo melhor. Todo o lucro da competição será revertido para esta campanha. Para mais informações, consulte a aba Campanha Beneficente. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLE2OFf9nh8). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, pois penalidades serão aplicadas rigorosamente de acordo com ele. O regulamento pode ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). Lembre-se de estar **pelo menos meia hora antes** de cada rodada que for participar e de fazer seu credenciamento no momento que chegar! **ENGLISH** Welcome to the second competition at Alto da XV Mall in partnership with Capivara! This competition is going to have a focus on "big cubes", so we will have generous cutoff times so everyone can participate and have fun. We will also have unofficial awards to the best women and newcomers in the 3x3x3 event. In this competition we are collecting donations for philanthropic purposes, therefore, in addition to having fun, we can also help make a better world. All profit from the competition will be directed to that campaign. For more information, check the Charitable Campaign tab. Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA). It is very important that you know the regulations, since penalties will be applied precisely according to them. The regulations can be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Remember to be at the venue at least **thirty minutes before** each event you will participate and to check in at the moment you arrive!

We are asking that all competitors bring at least one unopened 3x3 cube, which will be donated to a pediatric cancer patient. See the [Cube Against Cancer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerOC2025#53315-cube-against-cancer) tab for more information.** This competition is a part of the WCA Newcomer Month initiative. If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerOC2025#53308-competitor-responsibilities) tab. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. - Registrations will be accepted based on the following: - 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. - Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. - If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. - If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. - Please check the competition website for more information.

For more information, visit the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ColatinaOpen2025/register) tab; - We recommend arriving at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the start of the event you will participate in; - Make sure that the cube you will use in the competition is in good condition, as damaged cubes may not be accepted; - We are here to assist you! Reunirá a cuberos de todo el noroeste del Pacífico mexicano y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de modalidades y categorías. With the majestic Pacific Ocean at your back, “Mano Salada Mazatlán 2025” promises to be the tournament with the most spectacular view from your competitor station! It will bring together cubers from all over the northwestern Pacific region of Mexico and beyond, giving them the chance to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events and categories. Whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned pro, this tournament offers an opportunity for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is organized by the Sinaloa SpeedCube Team and Team Nayarit. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association (WCA) event. items.information: 🇧🇷 **Português** ** Bem-vindos à primeira competição de Cubo Mágico do Planalto Médio do Rio Grande do Sul !!!! ** Localizada no norte do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul, na região conhecida como Planalto Médio, a cidade de Passo Fundo destaca-se pela representatividade nas áreas médica, cultural, educacional, agrícola de precisão e tecnológica. Por estar localizada numa região estratégica do Rio Grande do Sul e próxima do centro e oeste de Santa Catarina, o Passo Fundo Cubing 2025 promete a inserção do Cubo Mágico em um espaço pouco alcançado até o momento, trazendo a promessa de crescimento do esporte numa verdadeira expansão para os atletas que buscam as possibilidades de participação nos campeonatos oficiais. Agora chegou a vez de Passo Fundo alcançar a representatividade também no Esporte para o Cérebro! Divulgar esse esporte em nível oficial, e levar aos competidores a oportunidade de participação, é o objetivo solidário da organização e dos apoiadores, especialmente da Secretaria Municipal de Educação e da Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, que apoiam o evento! Nos vemos lá! 🇬🇧 **English:** ** Welcome to the first speedcubing competition in Passo Fundo - Rio Grande do Sul !!!! ** Located in the north of the state of Rio Grande do Sul, in the region known as "middle plateau", the city of Passo Fundo stands out due to its representation in medical, cultural, educational, precision farming and technology areas. Since it is located in a strategical region in Rio Grande do Sul and close to the center and West of the state of Santa Catarina, this competition is a certain path to introducing speedcubing somewhere not fully reached yet, with the promise of growth to the sport, bringing a chace of participating in official competitions. Now it is Passo Fundo's turn to reach its representation in the mind sport too! Spreading this sport officially and taking the opportunity to the competitors are the objectives of the organisers and supporters, especially of Secretaria Municipal de Educação and of Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, who support the event! We will meet there!

items.name: Mental Breakdown Landvetter 2025
items.information: Välkomna till Mental Breakdown Landvetter 2025! Detta är en lite annorlunda tävling, med bara de mer avancerade grenarna som på årets SM kommer ha kvalgränser. Här är alltså en utmärkt chans att kvala in till dem! Därmed är det inte en tävling som typiskt sett passar nybörjare, men om men är flink på att lösa med ögonbindel eller FMC så är man givetvis varmt välkommen oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Además de ser un talentoso cubero, era un chico inteligente, creativo y divertido, y se le echa mucho de menos. --- #![Bandera UK](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0U5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2a28e3c285bf55a2606838971abb0514d0ef172c/UK.png) **English** If you are **Spanish Speedcubing Association (AES)** member on April 13, 2025 and you participate in the competition, you will be reimbursed €2.5 of the registration fee at the end of the competition. You can join AES by clicking [here](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/). El Corazón de la Axarquía 2025 is being held in honour of Owen Pérez, a young cuber who sadly suddenly passed away in 2024. Owen competed in the UMA Open 2023 and the Ecija Open 2024. As well as being a talented cuber, he was a smart, creative and fun boy, and he is greatly missed.

items.information: #Please check the schedule to find possible time slots. Please indicate in the registration comments what timeslot you would prefer to compete in. #Competitors may register for 3x3 and up to one of the following events: 2x2, Skewb, Pyraminx, Megaminx, Clock, or Square-1. Competitors may not register for more than two events, and if they register for two events, one of them must be 3x3. - On-site registration will be the expo's $30 entrance fee plus $5 paid to us on the spot. - Specify the time you would prefer to compete in the registration comments. We will email everyone their time slot once registration has closed. Time slots will be determined based on a first-come first-serve basis. If your desired time slot is full, we will reach out via email and ask for another time slot. - If you would like to modify your events you are registered for, please contact us through the contact form for this competition and we will modify your registration accordingly. *In a catastrophic event where the event will be compromised and cancelled, a full refund shall be offered to all competitors, in contrast to the typical 95% registration refunds.* ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcmhuIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--26e7dd6ac4909eb7484f685f1f010ff228529aaf/main.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcUJOIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--573fdf538a21acdaa5aaf068feb5551af8f5c1df/Logo_big.png) #This is an expo first! We will have things planned between 3x3 groups that isn't competing! - [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) presents another Bay Area Speedcubin' competition! - *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.* - We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. - Spectators will have to pay entry to the expo. Tickets may be purchased ahead of time at the [EVO Sports Expo website](https://www.evosportsglobal.com/evo-store/p/santa-clara-evo-expo-ticket) for $30, or in person the day of. - We urge competitors with spectators (especially minors) to not register for the first timeslot; however, a guardian (with a spectator ticket purchased) will be able to enter early with the competitors, it will be more straightforward to register for any timeslot but the first.

Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. items.information: # Première Compétition Officielle de Speedcubing en Côte d’Ivoire! Un moment historique! Rejoignez-nous le **samedi 19 avril** pour la toute première compétition officielle WCA en **Côte d’Ivoire**! Que vous soyez un compétiteur expérimenté ou un nouveau venu dans le monde du speedcubing, c’est l’occasion parfaite de participer à cet événement unique. Quatre épreuves officielles sont au programme : **3x3**, **2x2**, **Pyraminx** et **3x3 à une main**. Vous pouvez choisir de participer à l'une ou à toutes! **Première compétition WCA?** Pas de souci! Un **tutoriel pour les débutants** vous expliquera tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur la compétition et l’arbitrage. N’oubliez pas d’apporter une **pièce d’identité** pour l’inscription. Ne manquez pas cette occasion historique - venez résoudre, concourir et faire partie de la communauté grandissante du speedcubing en Côte d’Ivoire! # Ivory Coast’s First-Ever Official WCA Competition! History is being made! Join us on **Saturday, April 19th**, for the first-ever WCA speedcubing competition in **Ivory Coast**! Whether you're a seasoned competitor or brand new to cubing, this is your chance to be part of something special. We'll be holding four official events, including **3x3**, **2x2**, **Pyraminx**, and **One-Handed** - compete in any or all of them! **New to WCA competitions?** No worries! We’ll have a **newcomer tutorial** to guide you through competing and judging. Just bring a form of ID for registration, and get ready to experience the thrill of official speedcubing. Don’t miss this historic event - come solve, compete, and be part of Ivory Coast’s growing cubing community!

items.information: Varmt välkomna till den fjärde deltävlingen i vårsäsongen av Uppsalaligan 2025! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet (eller tidigare deltagande i serien). Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information. **Observera tävlingslokal på Österledskyrkan samt ovanlig starttid 16:20 p.g.a. annandag påsk.** -- A warm welcome to the fourth competition in the spring season of Uppsalaligan 2025! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience (or participation earlier in the league). Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information. **Note the competition venue at Österledskyrkan and the unusual starting time of 4:20 PM due to Easter Monday** [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.name: Beginner Big Cubes Ohio 2025
items.information: This competition takes place on a **Friday Evening** and features only big cubes (4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, and 7x7x7 Cube), and is for beginners or those who normally aren't able to compete in these cubes at other competitions. However, this competition might not be recommended for first-time competitors as it does not include the normal 3x3x3 Cube. For those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio.](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest or carpooling as spectator seating and parking spaces will be limited. All competitors will be expected to help out in the group they are not competing in.

items.name: FMC Canada 2025
items.information: ![(https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png) ## FMC Canada 2025 ### [EN] This competition is **Canada's championship for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves** as we will not hold the event at [Canadian Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChampionnatCanadien2025). The top-three Canadian competitors will be recognized for the national podium. This competition will have competitors simultaneously competing in 3x3x3 Fewest Moves at different locations across Canada with one winner. This isn't your typical speed solving competition as 3x3x3 Fewest Moves is the only event. This is an **exam-style event** in which competitors spend up to an hour finding the shortest solution they can and **writing it down on paper**. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 speed solving event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ### [FR] Cette compétition est le **Championnat canadien de 3x3x3 résolution optimisée (ou FMC)** car nous n'organiserons pas cette épreuve lors du [Championnat Canadien 2025] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChampionnatCanadien2025). Les trois premiers compétiteurs canadiens seront reconnus pour le podium national. Dans le cadre de cette compétition, des compétiteurs participeront simultanément à l'épreuve du 3x3x3 résolution optimisée à différents endroits au Canada et un seul gagnant sera désigné. Il ne s'agit pas d'une compétition typique où il faut résoudre le plus vite possible, car la seule épreuve est le 3x3x3 résolution optimisée. Il s'agit d'une **épreuve de type examen** au cours de laquelle les compétiteurs passent jusqu'à une heure à trouver la solution la plus courte possible et à **l'écrire sur papier**. Si vous cherchez à participer à une compétition de speedcubing plus classique, merci de chercher [une autre compétition au Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). --- ## Locations / Lieux ### [EN] Please see the [Locations tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2025#52204-locations-lieux) for more details. ### [FR] Merci de regarder [l'onglet lieux](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2025#52204-locations-lieux) pour plus de détails. --- ## Notice of Filming and Photography / Avis de droit à l'image ### [EN] Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ### [FR] Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Please Be Quiet This isn't your typical speed solving competition as ***blindfolded events*** are the only events. Blindfolded events require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 Cube event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ## FMC Canada 2025 We will take a break in the middle of the day to hold [FMC Canada 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2025) at the same venue. You may compete in both competitions, but **you must register for each competition separately**. ## Note for New Competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. You can also follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ## Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: # 본 대회는 3x3x3 종목이 없습니다. # [참관객 제한](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQKoreaSpring2025#53733-spectator-limit)이 존재합니다. ### 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대기자 명단에 등록됩니다. ### 신청 후 [참가자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/62/competitors)에서 본인의 이름을 확인하십시오. 이름이 보이지 않을 경우 [대기자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/62/waitlist)을 확인하여 주십시오. ### 주최측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인하시기 바랍니다. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ # There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition. # There is a [Spectator Limit](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQKoreaSpring2025#53733-spectator-limit). ### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist. ### After registration, please check your name on the [competitor list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/62/competitors). Please check the [waitlist](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/62/waitlist) if your name is not on the competitor list. ### Please be sure to check emails sent by the organizers. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with official WCA competitions.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NzQ0MzUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--5f765ba47cfdb6bb1045e4365d1173a5cf2989e5/RCO%202025%20(h_bg_white).jpg) ### PORTUGUÊS ### Sejam bem-vindos ao Rio Cubolympics 2025! Será um prazer recebê-los. **VEJA AS ATUALIZAÇÕES DA COMPETIÇÃO NO NOSSO INSTAGRAM** **@riocubolympics** Dicas: - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados. Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. Procure se divertir bastante! ### ENGLISH ### Welcome to Rio Cubolympics 2025! It will be a pleasure to welcome you. **SEE THE UPDATES OF THE COMPETITIONS ON OUR INSTAGRAM** **@riocubolympics** Tips: - Arrive at the competition location at least 30 minutes before the category you will participate in; - The cube you will compete with must be in good condition; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organization team and delegates. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we will always have room for new cubers. Have a lot of fun!

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## [EN] ### Registration Reminders **Registration will close on Wednesday April 23rd, 2025 at 10 pm (10 days before the competition)**. You must register and pay the registration fee before this date in order for your registration to be accepted. Late registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ## [FR] ### Rappels concernant l'inscription **Les inscriptions seront clôturées le mercredi 23 avril 2025 à 22h (10 jours avant la compétition)**. Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant cette date pour que votre inscription soit acceptée. Les inscriptions en retard ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez nous contacter en utilisant le lien *Contact Équipe organisatrice* en haut de cette page. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information: Welcome to Door County's fourth WCA Competition! We hope to see you here this May! If you have never competed before, this is a great first competition to attend. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [**WCA Regulations**](https://worldcubeassociation.org/regulations). You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook groups: [**Wisconsin and Illinois Speedcubing**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/2382471798653473) and [**Minnesota Cubing Community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) This competition is supported by the [**Midwest Cubing Association**](https://midwestcubing.org). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dEIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a6239c56608b03fda2194e41dd545ce91819975d/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png)

items.name: German Open 2025
items.information: In 2004, the first official German speedcubing competition was held: German Open 2004. The German Open have been held almost every year since and the German Open 2025 continue this traditional competition series! We would be happy if you'd join us and we hope you will enjoy the competition and have fun! Im Jahr 2004 fand der erste offizielle deutsche Speedcubing-Wettbewerb statt: German Open 2004. Seitdem finden die German Open fast jedes Jahr statt und die German Open 2025 setzen diese traditionelle Wettbewerbsreihe fort! Wir würden uns freuen, wenn ihr dabei seid und wünschen viel Spaß und Freude am Wettbewerb!

items.name: Peristeri Spring Open 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODAxNDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--3bff12c8b9b6016985d4932977574e412605ceb3/486747483_24056017737321961_6930283358538797018_n.jpg) Το Peristeri Spring Open 2025 θα είναι o τρίτος επίσημος διαγωνισμός της Ελλάδας για το 2025 και ο πρώτος που γίνεται ποτέ στον Δήμο Περιστερίου! Στην συνεδριακή αίθουσα του ΚΥΒΕ Περιστερίου για 2 μέρες παλιοί και νέοι, μικροί και μεγάλοι Cubers απ´ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο θα συναντηθούμε ξανά για το αγαπημένο μας χόμπυ. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μια ακόμα γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε έτοιμοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) The Peristeri Spring Open 2025 will be Greece’s third official competition of 2025 and the first ever to be held in the Municipality of Peristeri! For two days, in the conference hall of KYVE Peristeriou, cubers from all over the country and beyond—young and old, new and experienced—will come together once again for our favorite hobby. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and join us for another cubing celebration! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions. items.information: **Қазақша** QBERS League In Astana 2025 – Астанадағы ашық жарыс. Кез келген пәндер санына қатысу мүмкіндігімен базалық жарна 5000 теңгені құрайды. Жарыстың басты оқиғасы - QBERS League. QBERS League – турнирлік кронштейн форматында өтетін бейресми оқиға. QBERS League туралы қосымша ақпарат алу үшін қойындыларды қараңыз. Бұл жарыстарды QBERS TEAM ұйымдастырады. **Русский** QBERS League In Astana 2025 - это открытые соревнования в Астане. Базовый взнос с возможностью участия в любом количестве дисциплин составляет 5000. Главная событие сорвенований - QBERS League. QBERS League - это неоффицальный ивент, который будет проводиться в формате турнирной сетки. Подробнее про QBERS League смотрите во вкладках. Данные сореванования организованы QBERS TEAM. **English** QBERS League In Astana 2025 is an open competition in Astana. The base registration fee for any number of events is 5000 tenge. The main event of the competition is QBERS League. QBERS League is an unofficial event that will be held in the format of a tournament grid. For more information about QBERS League, see the tabs. These competition is organized by QBERS TEAM.

items.information: We're excited to welcome competitors back to Bozeman for another fun day of speedcubing! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition! Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. items.name: Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown I 2025
items.information: Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des Swisscubing Cup 2025. Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen. **Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2025 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden: 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ The Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2025, made of multiple competitions during the whole year. Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final. **Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2025 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup.

items.information: Varmt välkomna till den sjunde deltävlingen i vårsäsongen av Stockholmsligan 2025! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet (eller tidigare deltagande i serien). Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information. -- A warm welcome to the seventh competition in the spring season of Stockholmsligan 2025! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience (or participation earlier in the league). Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information. items.information: **3x3 will *not* be held at this competition!** This competition provides one last chance to set qualifying times for the [WCA World Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WC2025) in July. If you have not been to Northwestern before, allow at least 15 extra minutes to locate the venue. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://midwestcubing.org). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbVZoIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1b3d9004e1f9dfdbe319a8f4bd8117aa0a47de6b/image.png)

items.information: Välkomna till Sörmland Open 2025! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjQ5NTMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b91710c7b40613c5743dd60c80e9e302941e4524/Copy%20of%20Mololoa_logo.png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al Mololoa Open 2025, otra competencia en el hermoso estado de **Nayarit**!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 17 y domingo 18 de mayo de 2025. El Mololoa Open 2025 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ###### English Welcome to Mololoa Open 2025, another competition in the beautiful state of **Nayarit**! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, May 17, and Sunday, May 18, 2025. Mololoa Open 2025 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

We ask attendees to limit themselves to two guest per competitor if possible so that we do not go over capacity limits for this venue which is 240 people. Attendance is not required for the entire competition, however please arrive at least 15 minutes before your event's planned start time. Please bring your own cubes for the events you are competing in. **First Time Competitors:** All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY&ab_channel=SpeedcubingCanada) for a basic rundown of a competition. **Megaminx and Square-1:** There will be no cutoff for Megaminx or Square-1 at this competition. The cumulative time limit for megaminx is 30 minutes. You may take over 10 minutes to do a single solve if you let your judge know beforehand. Megaminx is scheduled such that overflow into lunch is acceptable so everyone can get results. **Draw prizes:** There will be draw prizes throughout the day to encourage competitors to stay after their round is done. **Notice of Filming and Photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Kölner Kubing 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDIwOTUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--7a09c07e7df2145faa8d4f7db972b8360df44444/KK25_New.png) ##### **German** Willkommen zurück beim Zauberwürfel Wettbewerb in Köln! Zum dritten Mal findet Kölner Kubing statt. Seid dabei, knackt eure Rekorde, egal ob Einsteiger oder Profi – habt Spaß an diesem Turnier. Schnappt euch euren Würfel und seid Teil dieses einzigartigen Events! **Wichtig!** Bei den letzten Competitions von Köln hatten wir in den ersten 5 Minuten über 150 Anmeldungen. Sorgt bitte dafür, dass ihr die Teilnahmegebühr **vor** der Online-Anmeldung bezahlt. Wenn Ihr überweisen müsst, macht das bitte 2-3 Tage vorher, damit die Zahlung rechtzeitig bei uns ankommt. Wir gehen wieder davon aus, dass auch Kölner Kubing 2025 innerhalb weniger Minuten voll sein wird! **English** Welcome back to the Rubik's Cube competition in Cologne! Kölner Kubing is taking place for the third time. Be there, break your records, whether you are a beginner or a pro - have fun at this tournament. Grab your cube and be part of this unique event! **Important!** In the last competitions in Cologne we had over 150 registrations in the first 5 minutes. Please make sure that you pay the entry fee **before** you register online. If you have to pay by bank transfer, please do so 2-3 days in advance so that we receive the payment in time. We assume that Kölner Kubing 2025 will again be full within a few minutes!

items.name: Saint-Augustin A 2025
items.information: ## [FR] ### Série Saint-Augustin 2025 Un week-end, deux compétitions! Nous organisons cette série de compétitions sur deux jours, pour offrir une variété maximale d'épreuves! Vous pouvez choisir entre [Saint-Augustin 2025 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (samedi) et [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (dimanche). Ces compétitions ont des événements différents. Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à ***une seule*** de ces deux compétitions. ***Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plus qu'une de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée***. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou vous inscrire à notre [liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ## [EN] ### Saint-Augustin 2025 Series One weekend, two competitions! We are running this two-day competition series, to offer the most event variety we can! You can choose between [Saint-Augustin 2024 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (Saturday) or [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (Sunday). These competitions are have different event sets. You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** ### Registration Reminders You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or join our [mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLE2OFf9nh8). É muito importante que você conheça o regulamento, que pode ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante (primeira competição)', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. Lembrando que se for sua primeira competição, você irá precisar levar um documento com foto. **English** It is with great joy that we announce the first Tatu Open Curitiba! Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA&t). It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner (first competition)', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event. Registrations during the competition will only be accepted for the 3x3x3 event. It is important to arrive half an hour before the events you'll participate in to do the check-in. Also remember that if this is your first competition, you'll need to bring a photo ID.

items.name: Saint-Augustin B 2025
items.information: ## [FR] ### Série Saint-Augustin 2025 Un week-end, deux compétitions! Nous organisons cette série de compétitions sur deux jours, pour offrir une variété maximale d'épreuves! Vous pouvez choisir entre [Saint-Augustin 2025 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (samedi) et [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (dimanche). Ces compétitions ont des événements différents. Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à ***une seule*** de ces deux compétitions. ***Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plus qu'une de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée***. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou vous inscrire à notre [liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ## [EN] ### Saint-Augustin 2025 Series One weekend, two competitions! We are running this two-day competition series, to offer the most event variety we can! You can choose between [Saint-Augustin 2024 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (Saturday) or [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (Sunday). These competitions are have different event sets. You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** ### Registration Reminders You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or join our [mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: ## Welcome to Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025! ### This competition is open to everyone to compete in, regardless of nationality or experience level. [![Kewbz](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1Y0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b3fb56d1f073b7544d2cf011acfe92e29f237f69/Kewbz_Logo.png)](https://ukspeedcubes.co.uk/) ![Scottish Championship Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTQyNTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c4ab4fd8fb34605abb30bab45291a8318375f865/Scottish%20Champs%20Logo.png) #### New Competitors: If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52598-faq) and the [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52599-important-information) tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. #### Free T-Shirt: By registering and attending Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025, you'll receive a free Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025 T-shirt! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size. A sizing guide is provided in the** [T-Shirt tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52603-t-shirt-sizes). #### Qualifications: **3x3, 2x2, 4x4, Skewb, Pyraminx, and 3x3 One-Handed do not have any qualification requirements and remain open to everyone, including new competitors, to compete in**. Other events have qualification requirements in place. If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025/#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by May 19th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. #### Spectators and Guests: Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There is no need to pre-book. #### Prizes: As this is the Kewbz Scottish Championship, **only competitors who are Scottish** (please see the [prizes eligiblity tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#53036-prizes-eligibility) for further details) **will be eligible for prizes**. The competition remains open for competitors of all nationalities and UK regions to compete. #### Podium Positions: If fewer than three Scottish competitors proceed to the final of an event, any remaining podium positions will be determined using the results of the highest ranked Scottish competitors in the previous round. #### Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025: The Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025 will be held separately on Saturday 24th May in Glasgow. This competition will host 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind, and 3x3 Fewest Moves. Podiummers at the Blind Off will be crowned at Kewbz Scottish Championship. #### Invitation Letters: Should you need a Visa invitation letter, or a note from us to help authorise time off school, please [get in touch](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=KewbzScottishChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition). #### Media Enquiries: Please [contact us](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=KewbzScottishChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition) for all media enquiries.

items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## Sponsorship ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjY5MTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--043850cb450564025444969edb4c94d522019cb1/image.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** will have discounted rates for accommodation for those wanting to overnight at the hotel during the weekend of the competition. Be sure to keep a lookout for more information in this regard. Their restaurant will also be open for meals and refreshments during the competition. Please see the Legacy Centurion Hotel tab for more information. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## NOTICE OF FILMING Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez nous contacter en utilisant le lien *Contact Équipe organisatrice* en haut de cette page. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ## [EN] ### Registration Reminders **Registration will close on Friday May 30th, 2025 at 8 pm.** You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODcyMzMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--125495dffb084fd15e0ce7c77c8990bee39bc694/image.png) **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το B' μέρος σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **μόνο σε έναν από τους δύο**. Ο 3x3 είναι και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς οπότε διαλέξτε με προσοχή ποια μέρα ή πoιο από τα 2x2 και Πυραμίδα ή 4x4 και 5x5 επιθυμείτε. Ελάτε να περάσουμε όμορφα καλωσορίζοντας το καλοκαίρι για ακόμα μία φορά στο αγαπημένο μας πλέον Rubicon. Σας περιμένουμε στο **ATHENS SUMMER BREAK B 2025.** Αγωνίσματα B' διαγωνισμού: * 3x3 * 4x4 * 5x5 Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) **Note:** This competition is part B of a series of two competitions. You can participate in **only one of the two**. 3x3 is in both contests so choose carefully which day or which of 2x2 and Pyraminx or 4x4 and 5x5 you prefer. Join un on the first summer competition of the year and have a good time once again at the familiar Rubicon venue. We are waiting for you in **ATHENS SUMMER BREAK B 2025.** Competition B events: * 3x3 * 4x4 * 5x5 Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2025! Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj. Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt. Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte! Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet. Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2025! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience. You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories. The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt. Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts! There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members. For NKF membership, please visit [NKF's website kubing.no](https://kubing.no/OmOss) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTcxOTcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b0423464106a5bf4730ca8189b9c1cd1a18f9149/Oslo%20Open%202025.PNG)

Cholula, sus 37 iglesias y sus aires prehispánicos están listos para recibirte en esta nueva competencia. Tendrás una sola ronda para demostrar por que eres el mejor. Cada segundo y resolución será decisiva desde el primer intento. ¿Tienes lo que se necesita para ser el más rápido? ¡Acepta el reto y gira hacia la victoria! Esto es, **¡Todo o Nada!** Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Municipo de **"San Andrés Cholula"** y a la Presidenta Municipal **Guadalupe Cuautle Torres**. Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 20215 es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). ​ ##### English ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Welcome to **Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 2025**! Cholula, with its 37 churches and pre-Hispanic spirit, is ready to welcome you to this new competition. You’ll have just one round to prove why you’re the best. Every second and every solve will be decisive from the very first attempt. Do you have what it takes to be the fastest? Take the challenge and twist your way to victory! This is All or Nothing! This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the Municipality of **San Andrés Cholula** and **Municipal President Guadalupe Cuautle Torres.** Todo o Nada - San Andrés Cholula 2025 is an official WCA competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.information: ***English version is below*** **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Linz Summer 2025 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Marcel Niedl und Sebastian Feichtinger und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar, Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Das Turnier findet im Volkshaus Ebelsberg statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! English: We are happy to announce the Linz Summer 2025 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Marcel Niedl and Sebastian Feichtinger and delegated by Viktor Kalmar, Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.
