items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAxNzc1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2d27809f1784d7222b898a07b6f26a4355886a37/image.png) # Português ​ A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. ​ Visando o bom andamento da competição, **ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador** nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram previstos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos, você compete; no outro, deverá ajudar a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. ​ **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores **menores de 18 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável**. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. ​ **COMPETIDORES NOVATOS** devem asssitir [a este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) para aprender como competir em uma competição oficial de Cubo Mágico. **Não haverá tutorial para competidores novatos no dia da competição** ​ As inscrições custam R$ 30,00 (trinta reais) a serem pagos antes do campeonato. A sua inscrição só será aceita após o cumprimento de todas as etapas de inscrição (pagamento e envio do comprovante por e-mail). ​ O pagamento da inscrição dá direito a um acompanhante. Convidados e espectadores, inclusive os responsáveis por menores de 18 anos, devem pagar uma taxa de R$ 10,00 (dez reais) para poderem ingressar no evento. ​ Inscrições no local serão aceitas no valor de R$ 40,00 (quarenta reais), caso haja vagas. ​ Acompanhantes e espectadores poderão comprar seu ingresso no dia pelo valor de R$ 15,00 (vinte reais), caso haja vagas. ​ **Estudantes do Colégio Integral terão desconto na inscrição, pagando uma taxa de R$ 15,00 (quinze reais) caso se inscrevam antes da competição e R$ 20,00 (vinte reais) caso se inscrevam no dia da competição.** ​ # English ​ Registration is open to any person, from any country. ​ To ensure the smooth running of the competition, **by registering for an event, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler** in that event (as provided by the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming overwhelming for just a few. Each event will have at least two groups for each event. In one of the groups, you compete; in the other you should help to scramble or as a judge. ​ **ATTENTION:** Competitors **under 18 must be accompanied by a guardian**. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children. ​ **FIRST TIME COMPETITORS** must watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) In order to learn how to compete in an official Rubik's Cube competition. **No tutorial for newcomers will occur at the competition** ​ Registration costs R$30.00 (thirty Brazilian reais) to be paid in advance. Your registration will only be accepted once all the registration steps have been completed (payment and sending of proof by e-mail, with all the information required). ​ Payment of registration fee guarantees the competitor a single companion. Guests and spectators, including the guardians of people under 18, must pay a fee of R$10.00 to enter the event. ​ On-site registrations will be accepted for R$40.00 (fourty Brazilian reais), if there are still places. ​ Guests and spectators can buy their tickets on the day for R$20.00 (twenty Brazilian reais), if there are still places. ​ **Colégio Integral students will have a descount. They will pay R$ 15.00 (fifteen brazilian reais) if they register prior to the competition and R$ 20.00 (twenty brazilian reais) if they register on the spot.**

items.information: # This competition has been moved to Long Beach! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors are **expected** to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). This competition **WILL NOT** have most sighted events, such as 3x3x3 Cube. We recommend first-time competitors not register for this competition. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized by CubeSC, USC's Rubik's Cube Club, in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAwMTA4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--daef33d7ae3aafcc06a39fef90bb4a22af1db024/WhatsApp%20Image%202025-06-03%20at%2019.29.40.jpeg) **ENGLISH** Welcome to the Cantoya Open Paracho 2025! This official WCA competition will take place in the charming Pueblo Mágico of Paracho, Michoacán, a town known for its rich craftsmanship and warm cultural heritage. The event will be held during the internationally renowned Cantoya Balloon Festival, a celebration filled with color, creativity, and tradition that attracts visitors from around the world. This edition of the competition will feature the following official events: 3x3x3, 3x3x3 One-Handed, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4x4, Pyraminx, and Skewb. It promises to be an unforgettable experience for both competitors and guests, blending the excitement of speedcubing with one of Mexico’s most vibrant cultural festivals. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/). **ESPAÑOL** ¡Bienvenidos al Cantoya Open Paracho 2025! Este torneo oficial de la WCA se llevará a cabo en el encantador Pueblo Mágico de Paracho, Michoacán, famoso por su tradición artesanal y su calidez cultural. La competencia se celebrará durante el reconocido Festival Internacional de Globos de Cantoya, un evento lleno de color, creatividad y tradición que reúne a visitantes de todo el mundo. En esta edición del torneo se disputarán las siguientes categorías oficiales: 3x3x3, 3x3x3 One Handed, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4x4, Pyraminx y Skewb. Será una experiencia inolvidable tanto para competidores como para acompañantes, combinando lo mejor del speedcubing con una de las celebraciones culturales más importantes de México. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAzMTc4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2f863d51aca44602df4916ae5a0e5ef1e278b5af/GO%202025.png) **Español** **¡Bienvenidos a Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2025!** La Guelaguetza es mucho más que una simple festividad, es el corazón mismo de la cultura oaxaqueña. Representa la esencia de la generosidad, la solidaridad y la comunidad que caracteriza a este hermoso estado de México. En la Guelaguetza, las personas se reúnen para compartir, celebrar y fortalecer los lazos que los unen como comunidad. Y ¿qué mejor manera de expresar esta conexión que a través de los cubos Rubik? Al resolver este rompecabezas, no solo estamos demostrando habilidad y destreza, sino también la capacidad de unirnos en un desafío común, sin importar nuestro origen o cultura. ¡No te pierdas la oportunidad de ser parte de este encuentro único, donde los cubos se convierten en símbolos de conexión y celebración! ¡Te esperamos en la **Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2025**! **English** **Welcome to Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2025!** The Guelaguetza is much more than just a celebration — it is the very heart of Oaxacan culture. It represents the essence of generosity, solidarity, and community that defines this beautiful state of Mexico. During Guelaguetza, people come together to share, celebrate, and strengthen the bonds that unite them as a community. And what better way to express this connection than through Rubik’s Cubes? By solving this puzzle, we are not only showcasing skill and dexterity, but also the ability to unite around a shared challenge, regardless of our background or culture. Don’t miss the chance to be part of this unique gathering, where cubes become symbols of connection and celebration! We’ll see you at **Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2025**!

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTc4NzgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--01c41a8280fe19ef88356bbc5b97d7c710f9edd2/Club%20de%20Speedcubing%20de%20l%E2%80%99Universit%C3%A9%20Laval.png)](https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61575052693279) ### (FR) ### Silence s'il vous plaît L'épreuve principale de cette compétition est la résolution optimisée, qui nécessite une quantité importante d'apprentissage, d'entraînement et de concentration. Toutes les personnes présentes, y compris les participants et les accompagnateurs, sont priées de ne pas faire de bruit afin de permettre aux participants de se concentrer. ### Note pour les nouveaux compétiteurs Bien que les novices soient les bienvenus s'ils savent faire le défi des moindres mouvements (3x3 Résolution optimisée), il se peut que cette compétition ne soit pas la meilleure expérience pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Veuillez envisager de vous inscrire à [une autre compétition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) si celle-ci ne vous convient pas. ### Liste de diffusion Nous travaillons fort pour répondre à la demande de compétitions au Québec et nous planifions et annonçons régulièrement de nouvelles compétitions. Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou (https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ### Club de speedcubing de l'Université Laval Les membres du Club de Speedcubing de l'Université Laval peuvent s'inscrire sans frais. Si vous êtes membre, inscrivez votre IDUL dans la zone des commentaires lorsque vous vous inscrivez puis ne payez pas les frais d'inscription. --- ### (EN) ### Please be quiet The main event in this competition is the Fewest Moves Challenge, which requires a great deal of learning, practice and concentration. All those present, including participants and guests, are asked to make no noise to enable the participants to concentrate. ### Note for new competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to participate in the Fewest Moves Challenge, this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. ### Mailing List We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in Quebec and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ### Speedcubing Club of Université Laval Members of the Laval University Speedcubing Club may register for free by writing their IDUL in the registration comments

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTE0MDI2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--796bec32f0666d29384682342b18ff943a53d2ee/NMLogo.png) ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Norgesmesterskapet i Kubing 2025, denne gangen hold i Lierskogen. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2025#55231-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇬🇧 Information Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2025, held in Lierskogen. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. items.name: Cape Cubes Winter 2025
items.information: Welcome to Cape Cubes Winter 2025! This competition will focus on a variety of popular events across two days, with a brand new format where we will do all the rounds of each event in a row, then move onto another event. Please look at the Schedule to see what this looks like, and when your events are due to begin. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" section, and pay for your entry. On-the-spot registration will be accepted, but it is still a good idea to register and pay online. Please see **Registration Requirements** below. ​ **SPONSOR** A huge thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) for sponsoring this competition! Please see the Sponsors tab for more information, and make sure to support the Cubestuff shop at the competition. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAwODIwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6f6279e9aecc7732beb40546a8e15830a644dfd6/cubestufflogocolourv2-2048x800.png) ​ **SPECTATORS** Spectators are welcome and can attend for free! Bring your family and friends to support! ​ **VOLUNTEERING** Please note that **all competitors** are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ​ **IMPORTANT NOTE ON VOLUNTEERING ASSIGNEMENTS** Please also check [Competition Groups](https://www.competitiongroups.com/) to see what groups you are in for competing as well as your running, judging and scrambling assignments. If you cannot make any of your assignments, it is **your** responsibility to find a replacement, and you must have a good reason for not being around for your assignment. Keep Competition Groups open during the day to ensure you never miss an assignment accidentally.

items.name: CF Goes Crazy Brzeziny 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA2MDU5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9099699a415c4020c460b8848aaf69949ce677ba/goes%20crazy%20wca.png) Drodzy, ekipa Cube Factory pragnie serdecznie zaprosić na jedyne w swoim rodzaju zawody side'owe! Chcemy dać Wam możliwość sprawdzenia swoich sił w konkurencjach blindowych oraz Big Cube'ach bez ciążącego na Was widma restrykcyjnych cut-offów, które zastąpione zostały wysokimi limitami kumulowanymi. Dzięki temu mniej zaawansowani zawodnicy będą mieli szansę na uzyskanie wyników których wcześniej nie byli w stanie osiągnąć! Oszaleliśmy? Być może 😉 Dear All, Cube Factory Team invites you to a unique side-events competition! We want to give you a chance to try your luck in big cubes and blinfolded events, without the strict cut-offs looming over you. Instead, we have replaced them with very generous cumulative time limits. This way, less experienced competitors will finally have a shot at achieving results that used to be out of reach! Have we Gone Crazy? Maybe 😉 ---- **WAŻNE / IMPORTANT** Ze względu na duży limit kumulowany dla konkurencji 4x4x4 Blindfolded oraz 5x5x5 Blindfolded doświadczeni zawodnicy mają możliwość rozpoczęcia swoich prób w trakcie trwania rundy. W takim wypadku, zgodnie z punktem 2u2) regulaminu WCA, zawodnikowi zostanie zmniejszony limit kumulowany o czas odpowiadający czasowi spóźnienia. Konkurencja 3x3x3 wiele kostek bez patrzenia posiada oddzielny limit zawodników, który wynosi 16. Konkurencja 4x4x4 bez patrzenia posiada oddzielny limit zawodników, który wynosi 16. Konkurencja 5x5x5 bez patrzenia posiada oddzielny limit zawodników, który wynosi 16. 3x3x3 Multi-Blind has a separate competitiors limit of 16. 4x4x4 Blindfolded has a separate competitiors limit of 16. 5x5x5 Blindfolded has a separate competitiors limit of 16.

items.name: FMC Tijuas II 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAzMzE5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1bebd0144612f93a0dcf3a3fe3a47b3623ad1272/image.png) Llega de nuevo a Tijuana el desafío más cerebral del speedcubing. FMC Tijuas II 2025 sube de nivel con la incorporación de Big Blind. Tres intentos, concentración total y ahora también resolución a ciegas. Aquí no gana quien corre más, sino quien piensa mejor. ¿Estás listo para enfrentarte al cubo sin verlo? ¿Estás listo para resolver con el menor número de movimientos? **Esta competencia no incluye 3x3** The most cerebral challenge in speedcubing returns to Tijuana. FMC Tijuas II 2025 takes it further with the addition of Big Blind. Three attempts, total focus, and now blindfolded solving. Victory doesn’t go to the fastest, but to the smartest. Are you ready to solve without seeing? Are you ready to move with precision? **This competition does not include 3x3**

items.name: Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA5MDA1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9132d12b3f016881cae138be00b2a5b4b234d103/1000017045.jpg) Zapraszamy na piątą edycję zawodów Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw! W tym roku najlepsi polscy i zagraniczni speedcuberzy będą rywalizować w sześciu konkurencjach, w których szykuje się niezwykle zacięta rywalizacja. Wydarzenie odbywa się w [Pałacu Kultury i Nauki](https://pkin.pl/) - jednym z najbardziej rozpoznawalnych miejsc w Polsce. Na zwycięzców czekają nagrody finansowe zapewnione przez [Fundację Szansa - Jesteśmy Razem](https://www.szansadlaniewidomych.org/). Turniej organizowany jest przez Fundację Szansa - Jesteśmy Razem wraz z Przemysławem Rogalskim i Piotrem Olszewskim. Wydarzenie finansowane jest ze środków [Miasta Stołecznego Warszawy](https://um.warszawa.pl/). Zadanie publiczne współfinansowane jest ze środków [Samorządu Województwa Mazowieckiego](https://mazowsze.waw.pl/). --- We invite you to the fifth edition of the Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw competition! This year, the best Polish and international cubers will compete in six very competitive events. The competition will take place in the Palace of Culture and Science - one of the most recognizable buildings in Poland. Financial prizes for the winners are provided by the Chance Foundation - We Are Together. The tournament is organized by the Szansa Foundation - We Are Together along with Przemysław Rogalski and Piotr Olszewski.

venue.name: [CEN del PRI] (https://maps.app.goo.gl/PRxeKopX66Yha7Wj6)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA2MzYyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b0266135e5081fb6c7c2e4bbc209d6826f5bea87/CEB%20logo.jpeg) ***Español*** **¡Hola Cubers! Somos Cubers te invita y te da la bienvenida al Cubing Express Buenavista 2025!** La siguiente comptetencia oficial de speedcubing celebrada en el Auditorio "Plutarco Elías Calles" en el CEN del PRI ubicado en la colonia Buenavista, lugar de la antigua estación de ferrocarriles que conectaba con la mayoría de las rutas de Ferrocarriles Nacionales de México hasta 1997. Ven y desafía tus límites, pon a prueba tus habilidades, conoce muchas más personas con la misma pasión por el cubo, disfruta de las dinámicas que tenemos preparadas para ti y sobre todo prepárate para resolver tus puzzles de la manera más Express. Te esperamos en el Acceso 1 del CEN del PRI este 16 y 17 de agosto. ¡TODOS A BORDO DEL CUBING EXPRESS! *Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [Reglamento.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)* ***English*** **Hello Cubers! Somos Cubers invites you and welcomes you to Cubing Express Buenavista 2025!** The next WCA speedcubing competition will be held in the "Plutarco Elías Calles" Auditorium at the PRI's National Center for Educational Development (CEN) located in the Buenavista neighborhood, the site of the old train station that served most of the Mexican National Railways (FERROCARRILES NACIONALES DE MÉXICO) routes until 1997. Come and challenge your limits, test your skills, meet many more people with the same passion for cubing, enjoy the dynamics we have prepared for you, and above all, get ready to solve your puzzles in the most Express way possible. We'll see you at Access 1 of the PRI's National Center for Educational Development (CEN) this August 16th and 17th. ALL ABOARD THE CUBING EXPRESS! *This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA [regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)*

items.information: Dicas: - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados. Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. Procure se divertir bastante! Tips: - Arrive at the competition location at least 30 minutes before the category you will participate in; - The cube you will compete with must be in good condition; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organization team and delegates. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we will always have room for new cubers. Have a lot of fun!

items.name: Rubik's UK Championship 2025

venue.name: University of Birmingham, Sports & Fitness
venue.address: Sport & Fitness, University of Birmingham, Edgbaston, Birmingham, B15 2TT

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODU1MTQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--cef753cc0422223e223e2696d2d751a45d058f8b/UKC25_LOGO_-_FOR_WCA_WEBSITE.jpg) ## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2025! ### This year's UK National Championship! #### Please read ALL tabs before registering. ##### Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There's no need to pre-book - feel free to drop in whenever you wish! **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2025, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2025 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.** **Newcomers:** Unfortunately, **this competition is not open to first-time competitors**. If you have not been to a competition before but would like to attend this one, you must attend another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org). **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2025#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by August 10th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **the only qualification for 2x2, 3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb is to have any average in the event.** **Final Round Advancements:** The top 6 UK competitors will be [guaranteed to progress](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#9p2b) into the finals for all events, in addition to the top 10 remaining best competitors of any region. For 3x3, the top 8 UK competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the finals. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at the Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2025. The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2025. **Prizes Eligiblity:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. **Filming and Photography:** Filming and photography will take place at the event. By entering the event premises, you acknowledge that you have been informed you may be photographed and recorded for media to be used by the UKCA and its partners.

items.information: ¡Llega a Puebla el torneo CUBING BUAP! Un encuentro único donde los mejores speedcubers del país (tú podrías ser uno de ellos) demostrarán su talento en una competencia de precisión, velocidad y estrategia. La categoría principal será nada más y nada menos que el legendario 3x3, el clásico que lo inició todo. Un cubo, seis colores y una sola meta: ¡resolverlo en el menor tiempo posible! Si eres un cubero experto que busca romper su récord o si estás dando tus primeros giros y quieres vivir la emoción de la competencia, CUBING BUAP es el escenario perfecto para ti. Habrá premios, regalos, emoción, y por supuesto… ¡muchos cubos girando al mismo tiempo! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTEwMzI1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3f71e2a1b95fa4fafef2e35ef0a08955e9e0e708/LOGO%20OFICIAL%20CUBING%20BUAP.png) The CUBING BUAP tournament is coming to Puebla! A unique gathering where the country's best speed cubers (you could be one of them) will showcase their talent in a competition of precision, speed, and strategy. The main category will be none other than the legendary 3x3, the classic that started it all. One cube, six colors, and one goal: solve it in the shortest time possible! Whether you're an expert cuber looking to break your record or are just taking your first spins and want to experience the thrill of competition, CUBING BUAP is the perfect venue for you. There will be prizes, giveaways, excitement, and of course... lots of cubes spinning at the same time!

items.information: *English:* This competition will hold **only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves event**, and it will be held in multiple locations, across Latin America. Please pay attention to the **date and time zone** of your [location](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCLatinAmerica2025#62723-locations-lugares)! Locations may be added until the 9th of august 23:59UTC so if there isn't a location near you yet contact your local [Delegate](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates) in Latin America. --- *Español:* Esta competencia tendrá **solo el evento 3x3x3 Menos Movimientos**, y se llevará a cabo en múltiples ubicaciones en América Latina. ¡Preste atención a la **fecha y zona horaria** de su [ubicación](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCLatinAmerica2025#62723-locations-lugares)! Se pueden agregar ubicaciones hasta el 9 de agosto a las 23:59 UTC, por lo que si aún no hay una ubicación cerca de usted, comuníquese con su [Delegado](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates) local en América Latina. --- *Português:* Esta competição contará **apenas com a modalidade 3x3x3 Menos Movimentos** e será realizada em vários locais da América Latina. Preste atenção à **data e fuso horário** da sua [localidade](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCLatinAmerica2025#62723-locations-lugares)! Os locais podem ser adicionados até 9 de agosto às 23h59 UTC, portanto, se ainda não houver um local próximo a você, entre em contato com o [Delegado](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates) local na América Latina.

items.name: UCLA Westerns Warmup 2025
items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCLAWesternsWarmup2025#62644-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) ### UCLA Students If you are a UCLA Student or Faculty member, your registration fee for this competition will be waived. Register for the competition without paying, and contact the [organization team](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=UCLAWesternsWarmup2025&contactRecipient=competition) with your credentials (such as a student ID) attached. Your registration will be accepted in the order in which this email is received.

items.name: Svealandsmästerskapet 2025
items.information: Välkomna till Svealandsmästerskapet 2025! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Svealand som kan vinna titlar och priser på Svealandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2025#60493-regionala-masterskap-2025-regional-championships-2025)". ----- Welcome to Svealandsmästerskapet 2025! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Svealand can win titles and prizes at the Svealand Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2025#60493-regionala-masterskap-2025-regional-championships-2025)". items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTEzOTc3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bde9ec161a7bab04eccdb3fc3331c34ff2b36f13/BAIANO%202025%20copiar.jpg) # Português ​ A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. ​ Visando o bom andamento da competição, **ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador** nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram previstos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos, você compete; no outro, deverá ajudar a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. ​ **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores **menores de 18 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável**. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. ​ **COMPETIDORES NOVATOS** devem asssitir [a este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) para aprender como competir em uma competição oficial de Cubo Mágico. **Não haverá tutorial para competidores novatos no dia da competição** ​ As inscrições custam R$ 30,00 (trinta reais) a serem pagos antes do campeonato. A sua inscrição só será aceita após o cumprimento de todas as etapas de inscrição (pagamento e envio do comprovante por e-mail). ​ O pagamento da inscrição dá direito a um acompanhante. Convidados e espectadores, inclusive os responsáveis por menores de 18 anos, devem pagar uma taxa de R$ 10,00 (dez reais) para poderem ingressar no evento. ​ Menores de 5 anos estão isentos de taxas ​ Inscrições no local serão aceitas no valor de R$ 40,00 (quarenta reais), caso haja vagas. ​ Acompanhantes e espectadores poderão comprar seu ingresso no dia pelo valor de R$ 15,00 (vinte reais), caso haja vagas. ​ # English ​ Registration is open to any person, from any country. ​ To ensure the smooth running of the competition, **by registering for an event, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler** in that event (as provided by the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming overwhelming for just a few. Each event will have at least two groups for each event. In one of the groups, you compete; in the other you should help to scramble or as a judge. ​ **ATTENTION:** Competitors **under 18 must be accompanied by a guardian**. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children. ​ **FIRST TIME COMPETITORS** must watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) In order to learn how to compete in an official Rubik's Cube competition. **No tutorial for newcomers will occur at the competition** ​ Registration costs R$30.00 (thirty Brazilian reais) to be paid in advance. Your registration will only be accepted once all the registration steps have been completed (payment and sending of proof by e-mail, with all the information required). ​ Payment of registration fee guarantees the competitor a single companion. Guests and spectators, including the guardians of people under 18, must pay a fee of R$10.00 to enter the event. ​ People under 5 years are exempt from the guest fee ​ On-site registrations will be accepted for R$40.00 (fourty Brazilian reais), if there are still places. ​ Guests and spectators can buy their tickets on the day for R$20.00 (twenty Brazilian reais), if there are still places. ​

items.information: 「Kanto Summer AM 2025」「Kanto Summer PM 2025」はWCAシリーズ大会です。 WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち一つにのみ参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 このページは「Kanto Summer AM 2025」のページです。 主催：くるくる会 https://kurukurukai.com Kanto Summer AM 2025 and Kanto Summer PM 2025 are recongnized as WCA series competitions. items.information: ![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/yztC4Jt.png) Questa competizione si svolgerà a Monterotondo (RM) e San Gregorio di Catania (CT) in contemporanea. ​ I partecipanti *DEVONO* specificare la città in cui desiderano partecipare nei commenti al momento della registrazione. **L'UNICO** evento di questa competizione è il **3x3x3 Fewest Moves**. Competitors should be seated and ready to start the attempts at the scheduled start times. **The registration fee for this competition is:** * €10 (Euro) for Cubing Italy Cubing Italy Members (note: this membership is free, see more below). * €20 (Euro) for Cubing Italy non-members (note: non-members will have to pay €10 online plus €10 on site if they decide not to become Member).

items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## Sponsorship ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjY5MTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--043850cb450564025444969edb4c94d522019cb1/image.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** will have discounted rates for accommodation for those wanting to overnight at the hotel during the weekend of the competition. Be sure to keep a lookout for more information in this regard. Their restaurant will also be open for meals and refreshments during the competition. Please see the Legacy Centurion Hotel tab for more information. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## NOTICE OF FILMING Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.name: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu IV 2025
items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information: **[Galo]** Enlist'ous **pour de ren** si qe v'étes un **nouvè coursou** ou ben un [**souétou de l'AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Aoterment d'aotr l'enlistement coûte 5 nuros. Merci de **ben lire les condicions d'enlistement, la [Faire ao qhessions](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) e les [ghides d'espliqes de l'AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. Sonjéz etout d'ergarder den l'ongllet [Programe](#competition-schedule). --- **[Brezhoneg]** **Digoust** eo an enskrivadur evit ar **genstriverien nevez** hag [**izili an AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). A-hend-all e koust an enskrivadur 5€. Mar plij, **lennit aketus ar c'hondisionoù evit lakaat e anv, an [FAG](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) ha [teulioù kennel an AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. Taolit ur sell d'an ivinell [Steuñvad](#competition-schedule) ivez. --- **[Français]** L’inscription est **gratuite** pour les **nouveaux compétiteurs** ainsi que les [**adhérents AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Si ce n'est pas votre cas, l'inscription coûte 5€. Merci de lire attentivement les **conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule). ---- **[English]** Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€. Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**. Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab. --- **[Esperanto]** Registriĝi estas **senpaga** por la **novaj konkursantoj** kaj [**AFS-membroj**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), ne gravas kia civitaneco vi havas aŭ kie vi loĝas. Alie, registriĝi kostas 5 eŭroj. Bonvolu legi la **registriĝajn kondiĉojn, la [oftajn demandojn](#57340-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) kaj la [AFS-lernilojn](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) zorgeme**. items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 170kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2025/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å være med. --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Sandnes Open 2025! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 170 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2025/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. **ATENÇÃO:** Devido ao tamanho do local da competição, apenas um acompanhante será permitido por competidor. Façamos a competição ser possível para todos os competidores! --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events. **ATTENTION:** Due to the size of the competition's venue, only one guest will be allowed per competitor. Please do not bring more guests than the allowed quantity, let's make the competition possible for all competitors!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAxNjY1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--cbb8741d80493ad5b6485076291772150d0aa596/LOGO%20FINAL%202025%201%20-%20COM%20FUNDO.png) ### 🇧🇷 Português Atenção: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar. Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com a organização. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DesafioNipoBrasileiroBH2025/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir. O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$30. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. ### 🇺🇸 English Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate. In case of withdrawal, please contact the organization. Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DesafioNipoBrasileiroBH2025/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. The registration fee is R$30. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment. By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.name: Don't DNS Denton 2025
items.information: ##### **This is not a normal competition with common events like 3x3 and 2x2. This competition features "quiet" and less common events, including the main event, 3x3 Fewest Moves, which offers 9 attempts total. For a more normal competition experience, check out the [many other competitions happening in Texas](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=USA&search=Texas&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&show_registration_status=on&display=list).** This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/). - Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DontDNSDenton2025#58932-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DontDNSDenton2025#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. items.information: Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor. FMC Europe 2025 is held at the same venue on the first day of this competition. A separate registration is required. Registration for this venue is free and can be done [here](https://fm.danskspeedcubingforening.dk/competitions/FMCEurope2025). Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija. FMC Europe 2025 järjestetään samalla kisapaikalla ensimmäisenä kilpailupäivänä. Erillinen ilmoittautuminen vaaditaan. Ilmoittaudu tälle kilpailupaikalle ilmaiseksi [täältä](https://fm.danskspeedcubingforening.dk/competitions/FMCEurope2025).

items.information: Chào mừng các bạn đến với giải đấu Hanoi Summer 2025! Giải Hanoi Summer lần này sẽ có hầu hết các bộ môn thi đấu, trong đó có nhiều môn có nhiều vòng thi. Xem thêm thông tin tại các tab. # Thông cáo về quay phim chụp ảnh Ban tổ chức và/hoặc các hãng truyền thông tại giải đấu có thể sẽ quay phim, chụp ảnh làm tư liệu về giải đấu. Bằng cách có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu, **bạn công nhận rằng bạn đã được thông báo về việc quay phim, chụp ảnh tại giải đấu, và hiểu rõ rằng tư liệu hình ảnh này sẽ được sử dụng cho mọi mục đích cần thiết của Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan. Bạn đồng thời cũng đồng ý cho phép Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan toàn quyền vĩnh viễn sử dụng những hình ảnh có diện mạo và/hoặc giọng nói của bạn cho mọi mục đích cần thiết.** Nếu bạn không đồng ý với các điều khoản trên, xin vui lòng không có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu. ________________________________________________________________ Welcome to Hanoi Summer 2025! This competition will offer most WCA-sanctioned events, many of which will have multiple rounds. Refer to the tabs for more information. # Notice on Filming and Photography The organizers and/or present media companies may perform filming and photography at the competition for usage as photographic material of the competition. By being present at the competition premises, **you acknowledge that you have been duly informed of any filming and photography that might take place at the competition, and fully acknowledge that the material may be used for any and all necessary purposes by the Vietnam Cube Association (VNCA) and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors. You also grant full, perpetual consent for VNCA and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors to use video and photographic material that contains your likeness and/or voice for any and all necessary purposes.** If you do not agree with the above terms, please do not be present at the competition premises. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBclJwIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2901c91547887dda589a7979741476bc143c0896/vietnamcube%20(1).png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTE0MjA1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c55a47d70262f951f2c856ebdbfa60eed0146aa1/Green%20and%20Yellow%20Tropical%20Summer%20Beach%20Party%20Instagram%20Post%20(1).png)

A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.information: Välkomna till en tävling i Örebro med ett fokus på sidogrenar och inofficiella grenar! Notera att varken 3x3 eller de andra mest populära grenarna hålls på denna tävling. Självklart är ändå alla varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Denna tävling kommer också att inkludera inofficiella grenar, regler och resultat hittas på [Cubing Contests](https://cubingcontests.com/competitions). Läs mer under fliken Inofficiella Grenar. Regardless, everyone is of course welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. As inscrições devem ser realizadas exclusivamente pelo site da WCA, mediante pagamento antecipado da taxa via PIX. A inscrição será confirmada apenas após a validação do pagamento. Para garantir o bom andamento do evento, ao se inscrever em uma modalidade você também assume o compromisso de atuar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria, conforme estabelecido pelas regras da WCA. Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, com as responsabilidades divididas entre todos os competidores. Em cada modalidade haverá, no mínimo, dois grupos: em um deles você competirá e, no outro, ajudará como juiz ou embaralhador. Ao efetuar sua inscrição, você autoriza a AACM, a WCA e seus parceiros a utilizarem gratuitamente sua imagem em fotos e filmagens realizadas durante o evento, inclusive para fins comerciais. **ATENÇÃO**: Devido à limitação de espaço no local da competição, cada competidor poderá levar apenas 1 convidado, mediante o pagamento de uma taxa de R$10. Contamos com a compreensão e colaboração de todos para que o evento seja organizado, seguro e agradável para todos os participantes. **ATENÇÃO**: No ato da inscrição, solicitamos que seja informado um telefone de contato no campo de observações. Caso seja necessário levar um acompanhante responsável, registre também o nome completo dele nesse mesmo campo. --- 🇺🇸 The competition is open to participants of all ages. Registrations must be made exclusively through the WCA website, with the entry fee paid in advance via PIX. Registration will only be confirmed after payment validation. To ensure the smooth running of the event, by registering for an event you also commit to serving as a judge or scrambler in that category, as established by the WCA regulations. In this way, the competition becomes self-sustainable, with responsibilities shared among all competitors. For each event, there will be at least two groups: in one you will compete, and in the other you will serve as a judge or scrambler. By completing your registration, you authorize AACM, WCA, and their partners to freely use your image in photos and videos taken during the event, including for commercial purposes. **ATTENTION:** Due to space limitations at the competition venue, each competitor may bring only 1 guest, upon payment of a R$10 fee. We kindly ask for everyone’s understanding and cooperation so the event remains organized, safe, and enjoyable for all participants. **ATTENTION:** At the time of registration, please provide a contact phone number in the remarks field. If it is necessary to bring a responsible companion, also include their full name in the same field.

items.name: Ottawa Blindfolded 2025
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## [EN] ### Please be Quiet All of the events at this competition are ***blindfolded events***, which require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. ### Note for New Competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. ### Registration Reminders **Registration will close on Friday September 19th 2025 at 10 pm (8 days before the competition)**. You must register and pay the registration fee before this date in order for your registration to be accepted. Late registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ## [FR] ### Silence s'il vous plaît Toutes les épreuves de cette compétition sont des épreuves ***avec les yeux bandés***, qui nécessitent une quantité importante d'apprentissage, d'entraînement et de concentration. Toutes les personnes présentes, y compris les participants et les accompagnateurs, sont priées de ne pas faire de bruit afin de permettre aux participants de se concentrer. ### Note pour les nouveaux compétiteurs Bien que les novices soient les bienvenus s'ils savent résoudre des casse-tête les yeux bandés (voir le règlement [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), il se peut que cette compétition ne soit pas la meilleure expérience pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Veuillez envisager de vous inscrire à [une autre compétition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) si celle-ci ne vous convient pas. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription **Les inscriptions seront clôturées le vendredi 19 septembre 2025 à 22h (8 jours avant la compétition)**. Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant cette date pour que votre inscription soit acceptée. Les inscriptions en retard ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez nous contacter en utilisant le lien *Contact Équipe organisatrice* en haut de cette page. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [Les bases d'une compétition officielle de la WCA](https://youtu.be/LH3QG7krdgc?feature=shared). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [À quoi s'attendre pour votre première compétition](https://youtu.be/yYZHzTc0GMc?feature=shared). Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: This Fewest Moves competition is part of CubingZA's South African National Championship for 2025, but is being hosted in several separate venues across the nation. Please see the **Locations** tab for more information. Please note that only the 3x3x3 Fewest Moves will be held officially - this is not an ideal competition for newcomers or those who only know speedsolving. Fewest Moves is comprised of 3 separate 1-hour attempts to solve the cube in the lowest possible number of moves. By WCA regulations, the puzzle must be solved in 80 moves or less (excluding rotations) in order to be a valid attempt, otherwise the result will be DNF. If you cannot solve the puzzle in 80 moves or less, please consider not registering for this event. There will be a short break in between attempts for grading, as well as snack/tea breaks for competitors. **GUESTS** Please note that guests and spectators are NOT welcome at this competition, unless special arrangements have been made prior to the event with the competition organisers (for example, for younger competitors that require a parent or guardian present). The venues are small and there must be absolute silence for the duration of each attempt.

items.name: Graz Open 2025
items.information: ##### *English version is below* ​ #### **Deutsch:** ​ Speedcubing ist auch 2025 wieder zurück in Graz! Wir freuen uns wieder ein offizielles WCA Turnier in Graz zu veranstalten. ​ Die Speedcubing Competition wird von Thomas Pucher, Fabian Staber und Felix Strasser organisiert sowie von Pranjal Khan und Viktor Kalmar delegiert. Die Competiton findet im Herzen von Graz am Campus Alte Technik der Technischen Universität Graz statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. ​ Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können, den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden, solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! ​ Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. ​ ​ Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ​ ----- ​ #### **English:** ​ Speedcubing is back in Graz! We are happy to announce another WCA Competition in Graz. ​ The Speedcubing Competition is organized by Thomas Pucher, Fabian Staber and Felix Strasser and delegated by Pranjal Khan and Viktor Kalmar. The competition will take place in the heart of Graz at the Campus Alte Technik of the Graz University of Technology. The results of this competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. ​ The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. ​ Every Competitor can bring one guest.

ATTENTION: On-site registrations will only be accepted for the 3x3x3 and the Pyraminx events. items.name: Blind Marathon in Rzeszów 2025
items.information: Zapraszamy na Blind Marathon in Rzeszów 2025 – zawody stworzone specjalnie dla fanów konkurencji blindowych! 🙈 To wydarzenie to prawdziwy maraton: w programie znajdziecie wyłącznie blindy, a dodatkowo coś naprawdę rzadkiego – dwie rundy dużych kostek bez patrzenia. To świetna okazja, by sprawdzić swoją wytrzymałość, koncentrację i zmierzyć się z wyzwaniem, którego nie spotyka się na co dzień. Jeśli blindy to Wasza pasja (albo chcecie wreszcie poczuć ich klimat na poważnie) – widzimy się w Rzeszowie! --- We are excited to invite you to Blind Marathon in Rzeszów 2025 – a competition dedicated entirely to blindfolded events! 🙈 This is a true marathon: the schedule includes only blindfolded events, and on top of that something truly rare – two rounds of big cube blindfolded solving. It’s a perfect opportunity to test your endurance, focus, and face a challenge you don’t get to see very often. If blindfolded solving is your passion (or you simply want to dive into its atmosphere for real) – see you in Rzeszów!

items.name: Please Be Quiet Waterloo 2025
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Please Be Quiet This is not a typical speed solving competition, as ***blindfolded events*** and ***Fewest Moves*** are the only events. Blindfolded events require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. Fewest Moves is an exam-style event in which competitors spend up to one hour finding the shortest solution they can and writing it down on paper. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 Cube event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ## Note for New Competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded and/or how to write out solutions on paper (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. You can also follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information: ### **Welcome to the first ever WCA Fewest Moves simultaneous competition in the Philippines!** This isn't your typical speed solving competition as **3x3x3 Fewest Moves** is the only event. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ ## First WCA competition in Chungcheongbuk-do! If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OkcheonAutumnBreeze2025#64080-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OkcheonAutumnBreeze2025#64079-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering. All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request. Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

You must register and pay the registration fee before this date in order for your registration to be accepted. Late registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ## [FR] ### Rappels concernant l'inscription **Les inscriptions seront clôturées le mercredi 8 octobre 2025 à 22h (10 jours avant la compétition)**. Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant cette date pour que votre inscription soit acceptée. Les inscriptions en retard ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez nous contacter en utilisant le lien *Contact Équipe organisatrice* en haut de cette page. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

You must register and pay the registration fee before this date in order for your registration to be accepted. Late registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page. ### Ottawa Side Events Series This competition is in a series with [Ottawa Side Events B 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OttawaSideEventsB2025). You will only be able to compete in one of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0).
